data.title: Expansion Intern | Austria or Netherlands
data.description:
Expansion Intern | Austria or Netherlands

Internship · Full-time · Berlin or Amsterdam

 

Our mission for you

Take trawa beyond borders!

As an Expansion Intern, you'll play a key role in taking trawa into new markets and will experience hands-on what it means to be an operator. You'll work across go-to-market, operations and product, and see up close what it takes to bring a fast-growing energy platform into a new country. We are hiring on a rolling basis, minimum duration is 3 months.

Two markets, one mission:

  • Austria: trawa is already live here, and you'll help scale the market: speeding up growth, sharpening our local positioning and turning our Austrian presence into a success story.

  • The Netherlands: trawa is preparing its Dutch market entry, and you'll help lay the foundations from day one: understanding the market, positioning trawa, supporting our first sales and commercial activities, and preparing everything for launch.

We staff you on the market where your profile and our needs fit best. Either way, you'll build something that truly matters.

 
 

What you'll do, whichever market you work on:

  • Supercharge local go-to-market: You research competitors, help define how trawa wins in your market and support early customer acquisition. Your work directly drives our local growth.

  • Turn regulation into a competitive edge: Energy markets change constantly. You track legal and regulatory updates, work out what they mean for trawa and help us adapt faster than anyone else.

  • Build local operations: You support product rollouts, from contract frameworks to processes, and help adapt what works at our Berlin HQ to the local market.

  • Shape the product for new markets: You bring local customer and market insights into our product team and help make sure trawa fits the needs of businesses in your country.

  • Become the market expert: You run ad-hoc analyses, build market overviews and quickly become the go-to person for everything specific to your country.

  • Collaborate with leadership: You work closely with our expansion leads and senior leadership. You take ownership of your own initiatives and see them through from idea to execution.

  • You are a true team player: You understand that humility and performance go hand in hand, and that what counts is the overall success of the team.

 

Who we are looking for

Standout candidates who want to grow with us:

  • Advanced Bachelor's student, in your gap year, Master's student, or recent graduate with outstanding academic achievements.

  • You have a strong track record. Analytical skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and a high degree of independence set you apart.

  • You’re highly motivated, hands-on, and eager to take real responsibility.

  • You have first practical experience in a dynamic startup, top-tier strategy consultancy or investment banking.

  • You're curious about the energy transition and are not scared of legal texts.

Market-specific requirements:

  • Austrian team: You are fluent in English and German (C1 or higher), and you're based in or willing to move to Berlin.

  • Dutch team: You are fluent in English, German and Dutch are a plus, and you're based in or willing to move to Amsterdam.

 

Why us?

  • Your impact: Your work has a direct influence on how trawa grows across Europe, and you get to help shape a new market from the ground up.

  • Flexible working: We foster a vibrant company culture where we love to work together, and home office is also an option. With flexible working hours and 30 vacation days, we support your work-life balance.

  • Attractive benefits: In addition to a competitive salary, you'll receive lunch vouchers, a learning and development budget and an Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Diversity & inclusion: Everyone is welcome at trawa! We are committed to an inclusive workplace that values diversity. We actively encourage people of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnic backgrounds, and physical or neurodiverse abilities to apply.

  • Application process: You'll receive feedback within a week. The process includes interviews, a practical challenge and conversations with our team.

Don't worry if you don't meet every single requirement. If you're excited about the role and our mission, we want to hear from you!

 

About us

trawa is a fast-growing energy start-up that is revolutionizing the way businesses procure and manage their energy consumption and costs. Our mission is to make sustainable energy accessible and affordable for every business. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about making a positive impact and contributing to our shared success.

data.description:
Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.

What you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

  • Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

  • Professional proficiency in Dutch and English.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

data.title: Product Manager / Product Owner (m/w/d) – kaufmännischer Fokus
data.description:
Du denkst kaufmännisch, verstehst technische Zusammenhänge und kannst Kundenanforderungen so übersetzen, dass Entwickler daraus gute Lösungen bauen können?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Unser Entwicklungsteam ist technisch sehr stark. Deine Aufgabe ist nicht, selbst zu entwickeln und auch nicht, eine klassische Scrum-PO-Rolle zu übernehmen. Du setzt den fachlichen und kaufmännischen Rahmen: Du verstehst, was Kunden brauchen, priorisierst Anforderungen, definierst das gewünschte Ergebnis und prüfst anschließend selbst, ob die Umsetzung funktioniert.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit: jemanden, der Themen voranbringt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, offene Punkte klärt und Verantwortung bis zum funktionierenden Ergebnis übernimmt. Reines Ticket-Pingpong ist nicht unser Verständnis von Product Ownership.

Aufgaben

  • Kundenfeedback und Anforderungen aufnehmen, hinterfragen und priorisieren
  • eigene Produktideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge entwickeln
  • Anforderungen klar und verständlich für unser Entwicklerteam formulieren
  • fachliche Rückfragen während der Umsetzung klären
  • neue Funktionen selbst testen und aus Produktsicht freigeben
  • passende Software- und Technologiepartner recherchieren, bewerten und ansprechen
  • Integrationen mit externen Partnern begleiten
  • insbesondere neue Payment Provider identifizieren und deren Integration koordinieren

Ein neues Feature kann dabei eine Softwarefunktion, eine Änderung an unseren Geräten oder die Integration eines externen Partners sein.

Qualifikation

  • kaufmännisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse
  • erste relevante Erfahrung in Product Management, Account Management, Customer Success, Projektmanagement oder Business Development
  • gutes technisches Verständnis – du musst nicht programmieren können, solltest dich aber sicher mit Entwicklern über Anforderungen und Funktionen austauschen können
  • eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • klare Kommunikation mit Kunden, Partnern und Entwicklern
  • eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Themen von allein weiterlaufen
  • Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben
  • fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Deutsch brauchst du für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden, Englisch für die tägliche Abstimmung mit unserem internationalen Entwicklerteam.

Erfahrung mit Payment oder Softwareintegrationen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit viel Verantwortung in einem schnell wachsenden, hochinnovativen Startup
  • Ein kleines, internationales Team mit Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt
  • Eine offene Arbeitskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und schnellen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein hundefreundliches Büro in zentraler Lage mit vielen Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung
  • Kostenlose EGYM Wellpass Mitgliedschaft für dein Workout

Die Rolle ist vor Ort im Büro angelegt, weil der direkte Austausch mit unserem Entwicklerteam ein zentraler Teil der Arbeit ist.

Du kannst Anforderungen persönlich besprechen, Fragen schnell klären und neue Funktionen direkt gemeinsam am Produkt testen.

Statt Anforderungen nur über Tickets weiterzureichen, arbeitest du eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die sie umsetzen.

Du gibst den Input, unser Entwicklerteam baut die Lösung – und du stellst durch Tests sicher, dass am Ende das Richtige herauskommt.

data.title: B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Jobbeschreibung

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und verändert als führender „Drive-to-Store“-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich die Einzelhandelslandschaft. Über unsere Plattformen „“ und „“ in Deutschland sowie „“ in Frankreich verbinden wir Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und erzielen so jeden Tag spürbare Wirkung.

Wir befinden uns mitten in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsorientierten, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Persönlichkeiten geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen. Wenn Du Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels mitgestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Als

B2B Marketing Manager (m/w/d) bei bonial bist Du verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien, die sich an unsere Geschäftskund:innen richten – von großen Handelsketten bis hin zu innovativen Markenpartnern. Du positionierst bonial als Vordenker im Bereich Retail Media und stärkst unsere Sichtbarkeit in relevanten Kanälen.

Deine Aufgaben:

Strategieentwicklung:

  • Entwicklung von Marketingstrategien zur Ansprache von Geschäftskund:innen
  • Positionierung der Marke bonial im B2B-Markt

Content-Marketing:

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der B2B-Content-Strategie entlang relevanter Zielgruppen, Themenfelder und Unternehmensziele
  • Leitung von Content-Initiativen einschließlich der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der bonial-Website
  • Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des bonial B2B-Newsletters, inklusive Themenplanung, visueller Gestaltung und Versand
  • Crossmediale Verlängerung von Inhalten über Website, Newsletter, LinkedIn und weitere relevante B2B-Kanäle
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit PR, Sales, Marketing, Product und weiteren Fachbereichen zur Entwicklung relevanter Inhalte
  • Analyse relevanter Content-KPIs und kontinuierliche Optimierung von Formaten und Themen
  • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Markenkommunikation und Corporate Identity über alle relevanten Content-Touchpoints

Kampagnenmanagement:

  • Einsatz von Performance-Marketing-Tools (z. B. LinkedIn Ads), um die Kampagneneffektivität zu steigern
  • Buchung von Anzeigen in relevanten digitalen Fachmagazinen (z. B. Horizont, Lebensmittelzeitung)

Messen & Eventmanagement:

  • Organisation der bonial-Präsenz auf Messen, Konferenzen und Networking-Events (z. B. Standaufbau, Speaker Slots, Sponsoring-Pakete)
  • Planung inkl. Einladungsmanagement von B2B-Events, die von bonial veranstaltet werden

Markt- & Wettbewerbsanalyse:

  • Beobachtung von Markttrends und Aktivitäten von Wettbewerbern
  • Analyse von Erkenntnissen und Ableitung strategischer Empfehlungen

Leadgenerierung & Qualifizierung:

  • Planung und Durchführung von Multichannel-Leadgenerierungskampagnen (z. B. über LinkedIn, E-Mail-Marketing, Webinare)
  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales-Team zur Qualifizierung von Leads und Unterstützung beim Aufbau der Sales-Pipeline

Reporting & KPIs:

  • Festlegung und Monitoring relevanter KPIs zur Messung der Marketingeffektivität
  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Performance-Analysen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

Stellenanforderungen

Dein Profil:

  • Abschluss in Marketing, Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in einem technologiegetriebenen oder digitalen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Marketing-Technologien (z. B. HubSpot, WordPress, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager)
  • Ausgezeichnete Projektmanagementfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu steuern
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von Events und Fachmessen
  • Gutes Gespür für relevante Inhalte und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (Niveau C1–C2) und Englisch
  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist, kooperative Denkweise und Begeisterung für funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

data.title: Investment Director (Diagnostics) - Lyon, France
data.description:
Location : Lyon, France

ABOUT ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, the US and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare. Our mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise positions us as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Priority areas include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech and Pharma Services. ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services.

ARCHIMED manages $11 billion across its funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based GP. MED I, MED II and MED Platform I are all top-decile performers for their vintage according to Preqin data. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

THE TEAM

  • An global team with complementary backgrounds across investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational disciplines.
  • Alumni of INSEAD, Wharton, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, École des Ponts ParisTech, ESSEC, Imperial College and Dartmouth, among others.
  • Professional backgrounds spanning Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, Capiton, Partners Group, KKR), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Jefferies) and Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Stryker, Phillips, Pfizer, Baxter, LivaNova, J&J, Galderma, Sanofi).

THE DIAGNOSTICS TEAM

The Director will serve as a senior investment professional with direct responsibility for sourcing, evaluating and executing investments across the Diagnostics portfolio. The Director will lead deal activity across an assigned geography, technology platform or investment theme, and will carry accountability for investment outcomes, value creation and portfolio company support.

This is a senior operating role combining strategic direction setting with hands-on deal execution, positioning the Director as a trusted senior advisor to Partners and portfolio management teams.

  • Investment Sourcing & Strategy
    • Drive sourcing and pipeline development across assigned Diagnostics sectors or geographies, identifying and cultivating relationships with sellers, intermediaries and LP co-investors.
    • Lead the formation and evolution of investment theses within assigned focus areas, including category mapping, competitive positioning and market trend analysis.
    • Serve as primary investment decision maker and deal sponsor, with direct accountability for investment committee presentations and recommendation.
    • Lead the negotiation of transaction terms, pricing and deal structure in partnership with Partners and external advisors.
  • Due Diligence & Execution
    • Oversee comprehensive commercial, financial and operational due diligence, working with external advisors to validate assumptions and identify key risks and levers.
    • Lead the development of post-acquisition value creation roadmaps, including 100-day plans and multi-year operating strategies.
    • Manage the investment committee approval process and coordinate all transaction closing mechanics with legal and finance teams.
  • Portfolio Leadership & Value Creation
    • Serve as the primary investment relationship owner for assigned portfolio companies, working directly with management teams on strategy, M&A, capital deployment and operational priorities.
    • Lead add-on acquisition identification, evaluation and execution, including syndication with co-investors.
    • Drive performance monitoring and problem-solving, escalating key decisions to Partners and intervention areas to senior management.
    • Sponsor and mentor portfolio company boards, ensuring robust governance and strategic clarity.
  • Team & Platform Development
    • Mentor and develop Senior Analysts and Associate-level team members, contributing to talent development and succession planning within the Diagnostics function.
    • Contribute to ARCHIMED's Diagnostics thought leadership and external positioning through conference participation, investor communication and industry engagement.
    • Identify and build capabilities across the Diagnostics platform to support scaling and evolution of the investment program.

Requirements

  • 8 to 12 years of investment or operating experience, with a strong track record in private equity investing, transaction execution or operational leadership within diagnostics sector.
  • Demonstrated success originating, evaluating and closing significant investments (€50 million+ enterprise value preferred), with evidence of value creation across the portfolio.
  • Deep expertise in the Diagnostics landscape, including brand strategy, omnichannel distribution, and regulatory dynamics .
  • Exceptional executive presence and communication skills. Able to command credibility with sophisticated management teams, institutional LPs and external partners.
  • Strong financial acumen and fluency with investment modeling, valuation and deal structuring. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required.
  • Proven operational judgment and the ability to translate market insights into concrete investment theses and deal opportunities.
  • Track record of building and leading high-performing teams. Comfort with mentoring junior professionals and shaping investment culture.
  • Strategic, entrepreneurial and partnership-minded. Takes ownership of outcomes, moves with pace and brings a builder's orientation to platform development.
  • Advanced degree preferred. MBA or equivalent experience strongly valued.
  • Embodies and reinforces ARCHIMED's cultural values of inclusion, meritocracy, partnership, accountability, client focus and trust.

data.title: (Senior) Programmatic Sales GSA
data.description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

As a Programmatic Sales GSA, you will be responsible for the automated and data-driven sale of our digital advertising inventory (primarily video and CTV) and report directly to the Director Sales All Markets. You will manage programmatic bookings, oversee the planning, implementation and optimisation of our initiatives to boost revenue in programmatic sales, and will therefore also be directly responsible for the optimisation and smooth, technical implementation of campaigns. This makes you the primary point of contact for agency trading desks in the GSA region regarding preferred deals and PMP strategies. You’ll also help with SSP and header bidding integrations and act as the link between Sales, Tech and AdOps.

THE ADS TEAM

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. With a presence in two countries (based in Berlin, Hamburg and Zurich) and operations in six countries, the Ads Team is a key driver of growth within Zattoo and has established itself as the market leader in CTV in Switzerland within a year.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.
  • Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.
  • Maximise inventory revenue, skilfully manage floor prices (minimum prices) and analyse delivery rates and CPMs.
  • Partner with regional sales teams in GSA to consult clients and pitch programmatic solutions.
  • Co-lead the technical and commercial setup of Header Bidding and additional SSP integrations for CTV.
  • First-line technical ownership of programmatic delivery.
  • Identify technical errors during delivery, analyse tracking issues and check campaign set-ups: troubleshoot deal delivery, floor pricing, and DSP configuration issues (e.g., SSAI, VAST responses, pod management, DSP/SSP bid stream mismatches).
  • Explain complex technical matters in simple terms to non-technical customers or internal departments.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • 4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)
  • A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products
  • Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)
  • Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations
  • Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills
  • Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate: trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

Die Rolle

Du bist Performance Ad Creative in unserem Growth Team. Unsere Performance-Agentur steuert Strategie, Testplan und Media Buying auf Meta und TikTok. Du baust die Ads: Statics und Video, Hooks und Varianten, in wöchentlichen Sprints. Aus jedem Gewinner machst du die nächste Generation.

Dafür verbindest du Daten mit Kreativität. Du weißt, was im E-Commerce gerade funktioniert, liest die Zahlen deiner Ads und machst daraus die nächste Idee. Du entwickelst und produzierst selbst, von Konzept und Skript bis zum fertigen Asset.

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Brand und Performance: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer Creative Direction zusammen, nutzt die Bildwelt der Marke als Fundament und sorgst dafür, dass Qstar auch in schnellen Ads erkennbar bleibt. Im Growth Team arbeitest du mit Shop Lead, Creator Marketing und Organic Social zusammen und berichtest regelmäßig, welche Ads laufen, was gewinnt und was als Nächstes getestet wird.

Was du machst

  • Du baust unsere Performance-Creative-Pipeline auf: von Idee und Briefing über Produktion bis Test und Auswertung, als wiederholbaren Prozess.

  • Du arbeitest in Wochensprints: jede Woche neue Ads in den Test, müde Ads werden ersetzt.

  • Du entwickelst eigene Konzepte, Hooks und Formate für Meta und TikTok und baust Static- und Video-Ads selbst.

  • Du liest Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Watch Time, CTR, CPM, Conversion Rate, CPA und ROAS, leitest daraus ab, was als Nächstes getestet wird, und multiplizierst, was gewinnt.

  • Du arbeitest im Testplan der Agentur, bekommst ihre Learnings und lieferst, was sie zum Skalieren braucht.

  • Du arbeitest mit dem Material, das da ist: Brand-Shootings, Bewegtbild aus dem Creative Department, Creator- und UGC-Content. Du zeigst, wo Shootings oder weitere Produktionen nötig sind. Templates und AI-Workflows sorgen für Tempo.

  • Du bleibst am Puls: welche Formate im E-Commerce gerade performen, was die besten D2C-Brands machen. Dieses Wissen bringst du ins Team.

Was du mitbringst

  • Zwei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung im Bau von Performance-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, in einer Agentur, einer Brand oder als Freelancer.

  • Ein Portfolio mit echten Ads, die live waren. Du kannst erklären, warum sie funktioniert haben oder nicht.

  • Du denkst in Hooks, den ersten drei Sekunden und Varianten, nicht in Einzelstücken.

  • Sicher in Figma oder Adobe für Statics und in CapCut, Premiere oder After Effects für Video. AI-Tools gehören zu deinem Alltag.

  • Du kennst Meta und TikTok von innen: Formate, Specs, was im Feed funktioniert und warum beide Plattformen unterschiedlich ticken.

  • Du arbeitest gern in einem System, bist schnell und hast trotzdem ein Auge für Marke. Du sagst uns, wenn eine Ad performt, aber nicht nach Qstar aussieht.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Nutrition oder Supplements und ein Gefühl dafür, was bei Health Claims geht und was nicht. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Deutsch fließend (mindestens C1). Du arbeitest hybrid in Hamburg.

Was wir bieten

Eine Rolle, die es bei uns noch nicht gibt und die du von Anfang an prägst, mit einem Launch Anfang 2027 und einem Sortiment, das wächst. Du siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit in Zahlen bewegt. Direkter Draht zu Growth, Creative Direction und den Gründern. Budget für Tools. Ein Büro in Hamburg, das wir gerade zum Content-Studio ausbauen. Hybrides Arbeiten. 48.000 bis 58.000 € brutto im Jahr, je nach Erfahrung. Und Produkte, die du selbst nutzen willst.

So läuft es

Ein erstes Gespräch mit Growth und Creative. Därt führst du uns durch dein Portfolio. Im zweiten Schritt stellst du uns vor, wie du ein Ad-System für Qstar aufbauen würdest. Diesen Case vergüten wir. Dann Kennenlernen im Team. Von der Bewerbung bis zur Entscheidung maximal drei Wochen.

Schick uns dein Portfolio mit Ads, die live waren, deinen Lebenslauf und drei Sätze zu einer Frage: Welche Ad aus deinem Feed hat dich zuletzt zum Kauf gebracht, und warum? Bewerbungen ohne Portfolio können wir nicht berücksichtigen.

data.title: Social Media Marketing Intern
data.description:
Your Impact

As a Social Media Marketing Intern at Gymondo, you will support our marketing team in building and developing our social media presence on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. You will contribute your own ideas, learn about the operational and strategic management of our channels, and take on real responsibilities from the start — from content ideas to implementation and performance analysis.

What You Will Achieve

  • You will assist in the development and implementation of Gymondo's social media strategy on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts
  • You will help create and maintain editorial plans aligned with our brand and marketing goals
  • You will create and edit video content and develop platform-specific formats
  • You will support the coordination of post-production, write captions, and plan content distribution
  • You will collaborate on social media projects — from concept to publication — and accompany campaigns, product launches, and feature releases
  • You will assist with social media reporting for events and fitness productions and help on-site with content creation
  • You will manage the Gymondo community on our channels, moderate comments and messages, and contribute to building a positive, inclusive community
  • You will monitor social media trends and platform updates and bring your own ideas for new content formats
  • You will help with tracking and analyzing content performance and learn to translate insights into concrete actions

What Makes You Stand Out

Must-have

  • Student in Marketing, Communication, or a related field
  • Initial experience with or strong interest in social media, video content, and storytelling
  • Basic knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube
  • Creative, proactive working style with a strong hands-on mentality
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • Good German and English language skills, both written and spoken

Nice-to-have

  • Initial experience with video editing apps (CapCut, Edits, TikTok, etc.)
  • Interest in paid social or boosting organic content
  • Basic knowledge of social media analytics or project management tools
  • Passion for fitness, wellbeing, and a healthy lifestyle

People Who Make a Difference

Gymondo is one of the leading digital platforms for fitness and nutrition in the German-speaking region — with over 2,000 workouts, holistic training programs, and smart nutrition plans. As part of the 7NXT Health Group, we help millions of people incorporate movement as a regular part of their daily lives.

We employ people who push each other, think critically, question, and grow together. We take responsibility — for our users, our products, and our environment.

Everyone Counts

We celebrate differences — and we mean it.

At Gymondo, we value diversity, openness, and teamwork. No matter what gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in, or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you are eager to help shape the future of fitness & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Do you need an accessible application process or have questions? Write to us — we will find a way.

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off
  • Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours
  • Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)
  • Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development
  • Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products
  • €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit
  • €1,000 annual training budget + a wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development
  • Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children
  • The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks
  • Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

data.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
  • Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
  • Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
  • Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
  • Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
  • Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

  • Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
  • Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
  • Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

  • DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
  • Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
  • GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
  • Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
  • Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
  • Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

  • Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
  • Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
  • Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
  • Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
  • A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

data.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
data.description:
About the team

Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you'll do

  • Architect, design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain ML infrastructure and pipelines to support efficient data processing, model training and serving.
  • Optimize and fine-tune machine learning models to improve accuracy, efficiency and scalability.
  • Collect, preprocess and clean large text datasets to ensure high-quality input for model training and evaluation.
  • Embrace software development principles, best practices and industry standards, including version control, CI/CD processes and unit testing frameworks as your day-to-day work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of machine learning solutions into software applications and platforms. 

You'll be great for this position if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science or an engineering-related field.
  • +8 years of proven experience working as a Machine Learning Engineer, focusing on building and deploying scalable machine learning or AI solutions and data-driven systems.
  • Relevant experience building AI products, such as Chatbot Assistant, RAG system, etc.
  • Excellent software development engineering skills to design computationally effective solutions and maintenance in large-scale production environments (data version control, model serving, continuous monitoring & alerting)
  • Experience building and deploying ML models using cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Expert in Python and familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, Langfuse).
  • Experience with machine learning workflow orchestration and algorithms optimisation, feature engineering pipelines, data ingestion and transformation. 
  • Good understanding of data pipelines, APIs, containers (Docker), and version control (Git).
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • You have working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English.

Why you should join SumUp:

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp.

🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team.

🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches.

About us:

SumUp is a leading financial technology company, founded in 2012 with the goal of empowering small businesses around the globe. We're the financial partner of choice for more than 4 million merchants in over 35 markets. We collectively build, plan and fine-tune the technology that drives SumUp and empowers small businesses around the world.

We believe in the everyday hero. Those who have the courage to follow their passion and who have the strength and determination to realise their dreams. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their business. With a founders mentality and a 'team-first attitude' our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by Company policy. data.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager für Meta & Google Ads (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Diese Stelle richtet sich an Leute mit echter Erfahrung. Du steuerst seit mindestens drei Jahren eigenverantwortlich Werbebudgets auf Meta und Google und hast zuletzt mindestens 50.000 Euro im Monat selbst verantwortet. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft und du Lust auf Tempo und Verantwortung hast, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens, weil wir im Team am schnellsten sind.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Performance unserer Kunden auf Meta und Google. Du entscheidest, wohin das Budget geht, was getestet wird und was skaliert. Du liest Zahlen so, dass du die Ursache findest und nicht nur das Symptom. Und du erklärst Kunden klar, was passiert und was als Nächstes kommt.

Konkret

  • Du steuerst Meta- und Google-Ads-Konten für E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands, von der Struktur bis zur Skalierung.
  • Du planst Budgets und Tests und entscheidest nach Profitabilität, nicht nur nach ROAS.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative-Team und sagst, welche Creatives deine Konten als Nächstes brauchen.
  • Du behältst Tracking und Datenqualität im Blick: Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions und GA4.
  • Du führst Kundengespräche auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn die Zahlen mal schlecht sind.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools für Analyse, Reporting und Routine und gibst dein Wissen im Team weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung von Meta und Google Ads.
  • Du hast zuletzt Monatsbudgets ab 50.000 Euro selbst verantwortet.
  • Du kennst E-Commerce- oder Leadgen-Konten aus der Praxis und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse nennen.
  • Du verstehst Attribution, Tracking und Unit Economics gut genug, um Zahlen zu hinterfragen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, mit Kunden und im Team.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil du mit unseren Kunden sprichst.
  • Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du Verantwortung für Ergebnisse willst und nicht nur für Aufgaben.
  • du Entscheidungen mit Zahlen begründest.
  • du im Team besser wirst und andere besser machst.
  • du neugierig auf AI bist und sie im Alltag einsetzt.

Noch nicht passend ist die Rolle, wenn

  • du gerade erst ins Performance Marketing einsteigst.
  • du Kampagnen bisher vor allem nach Vorgabe umgesetzt hast.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit TikTok oder Pinterest Ads.
  • Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo oder serverseitigem Tracking.
  • Agenturerfahrung mit mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig.

Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: eigene Kunden, eigene Budgets, eigene Entscheidungen.
  • Ein starkes Creative-Team im Haus, das liefert, was deine Konten brauchen.
  • Eigene AI-Workflows für Analyse und Reporting, damit du Zeit für Strategie hast.
  • Motiviertes High-Performance-Team, keine Politik, flache Hierarchien.
  • Spannende E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).
  • Benefitpaket mit Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen und Deutschlandticket.
  • Modernes, zentrales Office am Gärtnerplatz in München.
  • Team-Events, Workshops und Weiterbildungen.

Darauf schauen wir

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wichtig sind uns dein Lebenslauf und deine Antworten im Bewerbungsformular. Dort fragen wir nach deiner Erfahrung, deinem Budget und einem Konto, das du selbst gesteuert hast. Antworte bitte mit Zahlen.

Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese drei Angaben bitte in deinen Lebenslauf: Jahre Erfahrung, zuletzt verantwortetes Monatsbudget und ein Konto mit Ergebnis.

So geht es danach weiter: Videocall, eine kurze Case-Aufgabe, ein Probetag bei uns im Office mit persönlichem Gespräch, dann unsere Entscheidung.

data.description:
Wo bewirbst du dich?

Die ZUFALL logistics group ist ein familiengeführtes Logistikunternehmen mit über 2.000 Mitarbeiter:innen an 11 Standorten. Wir bieten unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Logistiklösungen und setzen dabei auf moderne Technik und Nachhaltigkeit.


Wozu brauchen wir diese Stelle?

Die Luft- und Seefracht ist ein wichtiger Wachstumsbereich der ZUFALL logistics group. Um unsere Marktposition weiter auszubauen und unsere strategischen Ziele zu erreichen, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die neue Geschäftspotenziale identifiziert, Kunden begeistert und langfristige Partnerschaften aufbaut. Wir suchen daher jemanden, der uns mit Motivation, Erfahrung, Markt- und Branchenkenntnis und einem ausgeprägten Gespür für nachhaltiges Wachstum unterstützt, diesen Weg zu gestalten.

Du kennst die Anforderungen globaler Lieferketten, verfügst über Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Luftfracht- und Seefrachtdienstleistungen und möchtest Deinen Vertriebserfolg in einem familiengeführten Logistikunternehmen mit starken Netzwerken und kurzen Entscheidungswegen weiter ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich.


Wie gestaltest du diese Stelle?

  • Du setzt die Vertriebsstrategie für den Bereich Luft- und Seefracht (Air & Sea) gemeinsam mit dem Senior Manager Air & Sea um
  • Du vermarktest unsere Dienstleistungen im Segment Luft- und Seefracht (LCL & FCL) im Bereich Import und Export
  • Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale und gewinnst aktiv Neukunden im Bereich internationale Logistik
  • Du verantwortest die Erreichung Deiner Vertriebs-, Umsatz- und Wachstumsziele
  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst bestehende Accounts weiter
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Wettbewerbstrends und bringst neue Vertriebsansätze ein
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren operativen Teams und internationalen Partnern zusammen


Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Du bringst einschlägige Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Luft- und Seefracht Dienstleistungen mit
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kundenumsätzen erzielt
  • Du schaffst es dich schnell in ein internationales Partnernetzwerk einzubringen 
  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Affinität „Türen zu öffnen“ und verstehst es dennoch als Team-Player zu agieren
  • Du überzeugst mit hervorragenden Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch 
  • Die Nutzung gängiger CRM-Tools und M365 sind für dich selbstverständlich

Hamburg mit der Option auf mobiles Arbeiten an 2-3 Tagen die Woche; 
dazu kommen Dienstreise je nach Bedarf


Deine Arbeitszeiten:

flexible Arbeitszeiten


Das bieten wir dir:

  • Schneller Einstieg durch einen bestehenden Lead-Pool und gezielte Vertriebsunterstützung
  • Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Air & Sea-Expert:innen, eingespielten operativen Teams und einem internationalen Partnernetzwerk

data.title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
data.description:
Your Role & How we work

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.

You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.

  • Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.

  • Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

  • Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.


The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.

  • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.


2 reasons why you should not apply

  • You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.

  • You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.


Your mindset

  • You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.

  • You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.

  • You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.

  • You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.

  • You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.


What we offer

  • Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.

  • Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.

  • A motivated, highly international team (15 nationalities) that gathers in person at our Berlin HQ and supports each other, with flat hierarchies and direct interaction with our management team and investors.

  • Visa sponsorship, relocation support, and a competitive compensation package with a meaningful variable component tied to fund performance.

data.title: (Senior) Accountant / Buchhalter (m/w/d)
data.description:
DEINE ROLLE

Als unser (Senior) Accountant / Buchhalter (m/w/d) verantwortest du die laufende Buchhaltung der BIT Capital, eines regulierten Wertpapierinstituts mit 3 Mrd. € AuM und berichtest an unseren Finance Manager Lachezar Georgiev.

In deiner Rolle fokussierst du dich auf:

  • Buchhaltung von A bis Z. Du verbuchst Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen in DATEV, steuerst die Zahlläufe, klärst offene Posten und führst die Anlagenbuchhaltung.

  • Der Monatsabschluss. Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss nach HGB vor und übergibst ihn bis zur zweiten Kalenderwoche an das Controlling.

  • Unterstützung beim Jahresabschluss. Du hilfst beim Jahresabschluss bis zum 20. Januar und interagierst mit dem Steuerbüro und unserer Wirtschaftsprüfung.

  • Reisekosten & Zahlungsverkehr. Du prüfst Reisekosten in Navan, gibst Zahlungen frei und behältst mit einer kurzfristigen Liquiditätsplanung den Überblick über die Zahlungsströme.

  • Automatisierung. Du baust Importe und Auswertungen, etwa aus Candis und Excel nach DATEV, und setzt KI dort ein, wo sie manuelle Arbeit ersetzt.

  • Meldewesen. Nach der Einarbeitung übernimmst du schrittweise Meldungen wie die AWV-Meldungen und gestaltest diesen Bereich mit.


Deine Erfahrung

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, idealerweise in der regulierten Finanzbranche (ein Plus, kein Muss).

  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung im Rechnungswesen oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium; eine Qualifikation als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) ist von Vorteil.

  • Du hast selbstständig in DATEV gebucht und Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB vorbereitet.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Excel, auch mit großen Exporten, Pivot-Tabellen und SVERWEIS.

  • Du arbeitest genau, erkennst Unstimmigkeiten früh und sprichst sie direkt an.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch; gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.


2 Gründe dich nicht zu bewerben

  • Du suchst eine Rolle in einem großen Buchhaltungsteam, in dem jede Person nur einen Teilbereich betreut? Bei uns verantwortest du die Buchhaltung einer Gesellschaft von Anfang bis Ende und gestaltest die Prozesse dahinter selbst.

  • Du möchtest feste Abläufe, die sich über Jahre nicht verändern? Wir bauen unsere Buchhaltung gerade aus und automatisieren sie, und du entscheidest mit, welche Werkzeuge wir dafür einsetzen.


Dein Mindset

  • Du besitzt eine Leidenschaft für Aktien, Finanzmärkte und Technologie.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag und denkst in deinem eigenen Aufgabengebiet konsequent an Automatisierung.

  • Fristen sind für dich verbindlich, und du planst deine Arbeit so, dass der Abschluss pünktlich steht.

  • Du gehst mit vertraulichen Informationen diskret um.

  • Du bringst Dinge zu Ende und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Die Verantwortung für die Buchhaltung eines wachsenden, regulierten Vermögensverwalters: Du gestaltest, statt zu verwalten.

  • Direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung, eine direkte Berichtslinie an Lachezar Georgiev (Finance Manager) und kurze Entscheidungswege in einem Team mit 50 Kolleg:innen aus 15 Nationen.

  • Raum, unsere Buchhaltung mit Candis, DATEV und KI weiter zu automatisieren und eigene Workflows aufzubauen.

  • Ein Umfeld, in dem das Team signifikant in die eigenen Fonds investiert ist und Technologie im Zentrum steht.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit oder 35 Stunden, mit der Option, später aufzustocken.

Intro

Every industrial company on our customer list, ZF, Schaeffler, Miele, Maersk, Lufthansa, is fighting the same challenge: margin erosion from tariffs, CBAM, and supply chains nobody fully understands anymore. We're not another SaaS tool competing for budget. We're the difference between a board that knows its cost exposure and one that finds out the hard way. As Account Executive, you own that conversation end to end, first call to signed contract, for the deals that actually move the needle.

Why this seat is different
The deals are long-cycle, technical, and multi-stakeholder, procurement, sustainability, and operations all in the room, often with conflicting priorities. If you've sold complex B2B SaaS where the win depends on translating technical value into board-level urgency, this is that seat, at a stage early enough that you'll shape how we do it, not just execute a playbook someone else wrote.


Your tasks

  • Own the entire sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, negotiation, close
  • Build and run your own outbound strategy across LinkedIn, phone, email, and your own network
  • Lead demos and presentations that translate technical product value into business urgency for enterprise buyers
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder enterprise deals (procurement, sustainability, technical) without losing momentum
  • Keep your pipeline clean and current in our CRM
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to keep what we sell aligned with what we can deliver
  • Bring market and competitor intel back to the team to sharpen our positioning


Your profile

  • Proven track record running full-cycle enterprise B2B SaaS sales, with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone

  • Comfortable managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with technical and non-technical buyers

  • Experience selling into industrial or regulated sectors (automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, logistics, chemicals) is a strong plus; we're equally interested in strong operators from adjacent complex B2B environments

  • Fluent in German and English; most of our enterprise buyers are German-speaking

  • Hands-on CRM experience (Salesforce or HubSpot)

Benefits

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

  • Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

  • Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (React Native, Swift or Kotlin), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

  • Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

  • Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Warsaw, and Amsterdam.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

  • Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

  • Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

  • Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

  • Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

  • Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus:

  • Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

  • Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.
