data.title: Embedded Control Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

  • Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

  • Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

  • Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

  • You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

  • You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.

  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.

data.title: Senior Radiochemist
data.description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.

data.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

  • Production Acceleration: Finding the bottlenecks between CAD/CAM data submission and shipped parts.

  • Tools for People: Building interfaces that make life easier for operators, engineers, and customers, whether that's a work instruction screen, a dashboard, or a self-service portal.


Importantly, you do not need prior experience in the manufacturing domain. We value a high level of curiosity and autonomy to find and solve problems.


What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3+ years as a software engineer with proven experience in shipping code to production, across backend and frontend

  • Broad Technical Range: Experience in systems design, architecture and implementation. In general, you don’t shy away from new technologies and pick up whatever the problem requires. Our current tech stack is: Rust, PostgreSQL, React,  Python, AWS.

  • End-to-End Ownership: From talking to the user, to schema, to API, to UI, to rollout. You don't hand off "the other half."

  • Industrial Grit: Comfortable spending time on the shop floor in Germany to understand how work actually happens and how your software interacts with precision machinery.

  • Autonomy: You are comfortable with diving into new topics, coming up with solutions and driving their implementation

  • Bonus points: Knowledge of manufacturing and how factories operate, basic understanding of the Manufacturing Automation Pyramid

  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Engineers who only work on frontend or only work on backend. You must be comfortable across the full stack.

  • People who need detailed specs before they start building. You'll work directly with users and define the solution yourself.

  • Developers who ship code and move on. You own the outcome — not just the PR.

  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of Europe. Your work directly enables the production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space

  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions, and have the authority to execute.

  • The Environment: You are building solutions to accelerate production in a 5,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial plastic and metal 3D printers. Your work affects production of physical parts from day one.

  • The Team: Growing team of experienced software engineers, who value an open feedback culture. You may (and are expected to) challenge the status quo, prior decisions and drive SAEKI’s way forward.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.

  • Location: Zurich HQ with occasional travel to Factory ONE in Munich, Germany


Apply

  • Resume: Focus on systems you've built and owned.

data.title: Senior Computational Geometry Engineer
data.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.


The Role

As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right.
You own the code that runs in the factory.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable.
  • B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged.
  • Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes.
  • Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. 
  • Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors.
  • End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service.
  • First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption.
  • Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point.
  • Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup.
  • On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland.


What we're not looking for

  • Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship.
  • CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them.
  • Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it.
  • People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job.
  • Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities.


What we offer

  • Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space.
  • Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute.
  • The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one.
  • The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity.
  • Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich.


Apply

Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned.
GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you.
Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first?

data.title: Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead
data.description:
Your Impact

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead to own the technical development, integration, and lifecycle management of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment.
The role covers Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, and Dynamics 365 Marketing, together with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, platform integrations, and related Azure services.
You will translate business requirements into robust technical solutions and determine when to use standard platform capabilities, configuration, low-code development, or custom code. The role combines hands-on platform development with technical leadership, solution governance, and long-term ownership.
This is primarily a Dynamics 365 and Power Platform role. Strong professional software development experience with C#/.NET, React, and TypeScript is a valuable asset where requirements justify custom extensions, components, services, or integrations.
You will work closely with business process owners across customer-facing teams, Technical Customer Support, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Corporate IT.
 
Your Contribution:

  • Own the platform: Set the technical direction for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, including architecture, environments, standards, and lifecycle management.
  • Deliver solutions: Design, configure, develop, test, deploy, and maintain solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Apps, and Power Automate.
  • Extend where needed: Develop Dataverse plug-ins, custom APIs, business logic, client-side extensions, and Power Apps Component Framework components when standard or low-code capabilities are insufficient.
  • Integrate enterprise systems: Design and maintain secure, reliable integrations between Dynamics 365, ERP, Microsoft 365, Azure, and other business systems.
  • Ensure engineering quality: Establish appropriate practices for source control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, documentation, security, and technical debt management.
  • Lead technical delivery: Translate business requirements into sound solution designs, guide implementation partners, resolve complex technical issues, and ensure delivered solutions meet agreed standards.


Role Boundaries and Collaboration

The Senior Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Technical Lead is accountable for:

  • Technical architecture and solution design across Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.

  • Acceptance of process and solution changes.
Data Engineering is accountable for:
  • Microsoft Fabric lakehouses and data pipelines.
  • Analytical data models and governed data products.
  • Power BI platform delivery and analytical reporting.
These roles collaborate on data contracts, data quality, lineage, security, and the reliable transfer of Dynamics 365 data into the analytical data platform.


Your Background

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions, ideally including Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.

  • Practical experience with Power Apps and Power Automate beyond basic configuration or citizen-development scenarios.
  • Experience extending Dynamics 365 and Dataverse using C# plug-ins, custom APIs, and JavaScript/TypeScript client-side extensions.
  • Experience with REST/OData, the Dataverse Web API, authentication, error handling, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Practical experience with Power Platform ALM, Git-based source control, CI/CD, testing, and controlled deployment across environments.
  • Sound understanding of enterprise application security, reliability, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Ability to translate business workflows into pragmatic technical solutions and make sound trade-offs between standard functionality, low-code development, and custom code.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, review solution designs and code, and work effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners
  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland
Strong plus / nice-to-have
  • Professional software development experience with C#/.NET, including production applications, backend services, APIs, or integration components.
  • Experience with React and TypeScript, particularly for custom user experiences or Power Apps Component Framework components.
  • Experience designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining custom software beyond Dynamics 365 and low-code solutions.
  • Experience with Azure integration services such as Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
  • Practical experience with Dynamics 365 Marketing (Customer Insights – Journeys).

  • Experience with Power Platform governance or enterprise-scale environment and solution management.
  • Familiarity with Copilot Studio or AI-enabled capabilities within Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), or comparable Microsoft Learn training supported by relevant practical experience.
Working style and profile
  • Combines deep Dynamics 365 and Power Platform expertise with pragmatic software engineering judgment.

data.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
data.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

     

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

  • Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

data.description:
Over ons
 
Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.
 
Operations Team
 
Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.

Jouw rol
 
Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.
 
Als werkstudent Claims & Legal Support ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.
 
Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt.

Jouw profiel
  • Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.
  • Claims behandelen. Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie.
  • Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.
  • Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen
  • Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur.

data.description:
Senior Director, International Markets – Europe & UK

Company Description

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world's first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative. 

In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly's proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly's innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME's Best Inventions and Fast Company's World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We're a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let's build something extraordinary together!

Job Description

This Senior Director will be a core member of the Butterfly sales growth team, reporting to the VP Global Growth & Customer Success. This leader will own Butterfly's commercial growth outside in Europe leading all sales across Europe and the UK.

A primary focus will be building, scaling, and managing Butterfly's European distribution network. This leader will own the full distributor lifecycle—from market prioritization and partner identification through negotiation, onboarding, launch, sell-through, and ongoing performance management.

You will lay the foundations of the commercial function at Nopan: pipeline discipline, CRM, materials, repeatable approach and help us hire the people who come after you. This is not a back-office contracts seat. At an AI governance company, legal judgment sits close to the product and to every enterprise deal. data.description:
Join us in building the ultimate online playground!

Poki is on a mission to create the ultimate online playground, bringing easy access to the best games on web to over 100 million monthly players worldwide. These games are created by a dynamic global community of 500+ game developer teams. At the core of our work lies a simple belief: play is how we learn. This value is embodied by our team of 70 unique individuals who each bring something special to the table.

What this job is about

As a senior Frontend Developer at Poki, you'll shape how players experience our platform. All the way from the first vague problem to what happens after release. That might mean improving discovery on a slow connection, running an experiment, building a tool for our Content team, or fixing a part of the stack everyone has quietly learned to work around.

This is a senior role. That means we're looking for judgement, not just throughput.

Your Challenge as a senior Frontend Developer

  • Frontend that works on real devices. That means a three-year-old Android phone on unreliable wifi, not just the MacBook that will run anything you throw at it. If it only feels smooth on your machine, it is not done.

  • Clear work from vague problems. You turn "players are leaving on slow connections" into a sensible scope, a first slice and a clear opinion about what can wait.

  • Results you can point at. Decide what success looks like before you build, then use A/B tests and our data to see if you got there. If nothing moves, say so. Sometimes the right result is killing the thing you just built.

  • Ownership in production. You build in enough monitoring to know when your work breaks, then stay with it until it is fixed. Shipping is the start of ownership, not the end.

  • A stronger engineering team. Your reviews teach, your pairing unblocks people and the patterns you leave behind make the next piece of work easier.

  • A stack and a codebase that survive contact with other people. You understand what still earns its place, what is hanging around through habit, and when changing it is worth the cost. What you leave behind, code and reasoning both, still makes sense six months later when the context is gone and somebody else needs to change it.

  • Visible progress in small slices. Something useful in a week beats something theoretically perfect in two months. It also tells you much sooner when the idea was wrong.

You

  • Ownership of the whole scope, judgement before throughput. That includes the awkward parts that nobody volunteered for. The goal is not to produce more code, it is to build the right thing.

  • Strong, production-level experience with React, Redux, TypeScript, HTML and CSS (7+ years). You've shipped and maintained SPAs at scale, not just built one from a tutorial, and you know where the codebase tends to rot if nobody's watching.

  • Write tests with a reason. Use Playwright or something similar where it catches real problems, not because a coverage number looks better.

  • Use AI to move faster while keeping the judgment, understanding and outcome yours. You do not ship something you cannot explain.

  • Build something small and measure it. That turns gut feeling into evidence and shows which ideas deserve to become real features.

  • Disagree properly, then commit. Make the case early and explain the tradeoffs in terms engineers and non-engineers can understand. Once the call is made you are in, including when it went the other way.

At Duna, we see the company as the second product we’re building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We’re backed by world-class investors including Index Ventures as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI, Goldman Sachs.


Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE

  • Design and build backend systems that are clean, testable, and efficient

  • Ship customer-facing features as an engineer in one of our product teams

  • Work closely with Deployment, go-to-market teams and our customers to bring them to life

  • Turn repeated setup work into product improvements

  • Bring care to testing, quality, and long-term maintainability

  • Shape our engineering practices and technical culture

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3 to 5+ years as a backend engineer at a modern tech company

  • High level of ownership and care for your work, with a track record to show for it

  • You enjoy working with customers and can explain technical things to people who aren't engineers

  • You take feedback quickly and turn it into growth

  • Curiosity

  • Big ambitions

  • Kindness

Bonus if you've worked on AI features and how to evaluate them, or on product analytics.

Our current stack includes Node.js + TypeScript, Event Sourcing, Express, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, AWS. Experience with these is a plus, but not required. We are more excited about how you approach problems and find solutions.

A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company.

We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application!

data.title: (Senior) Infrastructure & Security Engineer

At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI and Goldman Sachs.

Duna's infrastructure is part of the product. Enterprise customers buy our reliability, security posture and auditability, not just our features.

Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE

  • Own and harden our platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Postgres, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and incident response

  • Make security the default, with least privilege, secrets management and tenant isolation built into the platform instead of bolted on later

  • Turn our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments into controls and evidence that are automated, not a yearly scramble

  • Turn recurring operational toil into self-service systems that engineers actually adopt, from preview environments to internal access

  • Help Duna run AI agents in engineering safely, with the sandboxes, guardrails and human checkpoints that make it possible

  • Take calm ownership of incidents, and make sure the system gets better afterwards, not just the moment

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Deep, hands-on experience with AWS (or comparable), Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability

  • Real security engineering skills: you turn least privilege and auditability requirements into working systems

  • Comfort with the enterprise IT side of a startup, from certifications and customer security reviews to identity and device management

  • High agency in ambiguity, turning a vague problem into a shipped plan

  • Pragmatic judgement about when to harden, when to simplify and when to leave something alone

  • Curiosity about what AI changes in how we build and run software

Our platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes with Terraform, Postgres and RabbitMQ, alongside a Node.js and TypeScript product stack built on event sourcing. You will not have used all of it before. We care more about the depth you bring and how you pick up the rest.

data.description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we’re building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Duna is growing fast, and we're really excited to bring a Head of Content onboard to help shape our voice.

"At a period when most content sounds the same because of AI, compelling content and tone of voice is an even more important differentiator. ." — Duco, Co-founder

Since your role will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

What you'll be doing in this role

  • Founder-led content: own our founders' LinkedIn presence. Turn their thinking, customer conversations, and opinions into posts that sound unmistakably like them and get read by the people we sell to

  • Social media content: own LinkedIn content and regular posting of Duna

  • Long-form content: write blogs, white papers, case studies

  • Brand voice: guard our tone of voice across everything we publish, from the website to press releases

What we're looking for

  • 3-8 years of experience - this doesn't necessarily have to be as a content writer. We look for someone who demonstrates clear talent or passion for great copy — this can also be outside of your work

  • Exceptional writing talent — we don't want to sound like a mediocre AI prompt filled with lofty words

  • You can write in someone else's voice. Ghostwriting for an executive, running a founder's LinkedIn, or comparable proof that you can disappear into another person's way of thinking

data.title: Quality Officer
data.description:
Bij Crisp willen we beter eten mogelijk maken voor meer mensen. Dat begint met eten waar je op kunt vertrouwen: veilig, hygiënisch en elke keer net zo goed als we beloven. Daarom zorg jij ervoor dat kwaliteit, hygiëne en voedselveiligheid op de productievloer elke dag kloppen. Je bent onze ogen en oren op de vloer. Het fundament staat als een huis: HACCP, kwaliteit en specificatiebeheer zijn op orde. Jij zorgt dat de praktijk daar dagelijks bij aansluit en je stuurt bij waar het nodig is. Je bent veel op de productievloer te vinden voor controles en om processen te verifiëren. Af en toe zit je in ons eigen lab voor experimenten en testen.

Wat deze rol zo leuk maakt? Je hebt direct invloed op ons product en je zit er altijd dichtbij. Schuurt het ergens op kwaliteit, dan ben jij het aanspreekpunt voor de productie. Klachten pak je grondig op en je zoekt praktische oplossingen.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je loopt dagelijks kwaliteits- en hygiënerondes op de productievloer. Je controleert of collega’s de werkwijzen en kwaliteitsstandaarden naleven.

  • Je neemt monsters en doet snelle producttesten en metingen, zoals pH en temperatuur. Ook controleer je inkomende grondstoffen en inkoopartikelen.

  • Je voert gerichte controle- en testprogramma’s uit op smaak, microbiologie, chemie, fysieke eigenschappen en allergenen, bij processen, grondstoffen en eindproducten.

  • Je coördineert en interpreteert laboratoriumonderzoeken (M/C/F/A) en voert houdbaarheidsstudies uit.

  • Je coördineert en zet smaaktesten en proeverijen in.

  • Je onderzoekt klachten van klanten over producten grondig. Je duikt de productie in, achterhaalt waar het misging en borgt de oplossing.

  • Je let op de juiste toepassing van onze vaste productspecificaties en etiketteringseisen tijdens de productie.

  • Je controleert, test en kalibreert meet- en weegapparatuur.

  • Je spreekt productiemedewerkers aan, coacht ze en geeft korte, praktische trainingen en instructies, bijvoorbeeld over hygiëne en allergenen. Zo tillen we de voedselveiligheidscultuur elke dag naar een hoger niveau.

  • Afhankelijk van je ambities en ervaring is er ruimte om mee te denken over productontwikkeling, bezoek je leveranciers om grondstoffen aan de bron te toetsen, help je bij inkoop en hygiënemanagement en ondersteun je bij kwaliteit in warehouse en logistiek.

Dit ben jij

  • Je bent praktisch en zichtbaar. Je zit niet graag hele dagen achter een bureau. Jij bent op je best op de productievloer.

  • Je bent een goede communicator en coach. Je legt kwaliteitsregels helder uit en spreekt collega’s op een prettige, opbouwende manier aan als iemand zich er niet aan houdt.

  • Je bent kritisch en nauwkeurig. Je let op details, kijkt scherp naar het proces en neemt geen genoegen met half werk.

  • Je bent zelfredzaam en oplossingsgericht. Je pakt zaken zelf op, weet bij wie je moet zijn en komt je afspraken na.

  • Je bent flexibel. Loopt je dag op de vloer anders door een kwaliteitsprobleem of een urgente klacht? Dan schakel je snel en pas je je prioriteiten aan.

  • Je hebt minimaal MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt gedegen basiskennis van levensmiddelen (microbiologie, chemie en allergenen). Je weet hoe kruisbesmetting werkt en kunt labuitslagen interpreteren.

  • Je kent de basis van HACCP, de hygiënecode, algemene warenwetgeving en GFSI-normen, zoals BRCGS, IFS of FSSC 22000.

  • Pre: een opleiding in Levensmiddelentechnologie, Voedingskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

data.title: Veiligheidskunde & Arbo stage
data.description:
Bij Crisp denken we na over de toekomst van boodschappen: zo duurzaam en zo snel mogelijk bij de klant thuis bezorgd. Het klaarmaken van die boodschappen gebeurt vanuit ons warehouse in Amsterdam, waar elke dag een groot team verse producten ontvangt, verzamelt en op pad stuurt. Een veilige en gezonde werkplek voor al die collega's is voor ons geen bijzaak maar de basis. Als stagiair Veiligheidskunde help je ons die basis elke dag sterker te maken: van de werkvloer tot het beleid. Kom jij vanaf januari of februari 2027 ons team versterken?

Wat je gaat doen

Samen met het Facility-team zorg je voor een goed draaiend warehouse in Amsterdam. Je helpt mee om voorraadbeheer, intern transportmateriaal, onderhoud en processen te verbeteren. Daarnaast houd je de beschikbaarheid van voorraad in de gaten en ondersteun je bij ad hoc projecten en taken. Ook draag je eraan bij dat de Crisp-cultuur in de hele organisatie nog meer gaat leven. Jouw stage bevat onder andere de volgende uitdagingen:

  • Samen met het Facility-team verzorg je de bevoorrading, coördineer je facilitaire werkzaamheden en ga je aan de slag met onderhoud.

  • Je organiseert facilitaire werkzaamheden, zoals verbeteringen in het proces, en onderzoekt hoe we kosten kunnen verlagen en duurzamer kunnen werken.

  • Je speelt een rol in projecten om onze warehouses te voorzien van de juiste facilitaire voorzieningen.

  • Het Facility-team ondersteunt alle Crisp-locaties. Van leveranciers tot andere bezoekers: jij bent het eerste aanspreekpunt en ondersteunt het warehouse bij onderhoud en projectmanagement.

  • Je denkt mee over plannen om de facilitaire voorzieningen in ons warehouse uit te breiden en te verbeteren, zodat we kosten besparen en efficiënter kunnen werken.

  • Je helpt inzichtelijk te maken waar de kosten in ons onderhoudsproces zitten en waar we het meest kunnen besparen.

  • Samen met het Facility-team onderzoek je de mogelijkheden voor kostenbesparing op facilitair gebied, in lijn met onze kernwaarden.

Dit ben jij

Voor jouw HBO opleiding ben je op zoek naar een fulltime meewerkstage. Daarnaast bezit je over het volgende:

  • Je volgt momenteel een HBO opleiding.

  • Je bent minimaal 5 maanden beschikbaar.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage/ onderzoeksstage (in overleg).

  • Je bent een representatieve en ondernemende collega

  • Je bent planning technisch sterk en gaat gestructureerd te werk.

  • Je bent goed in staat zelfstandig en proactief te werken.

  • Je bent een durver en bent niet bang om zelf actie te ondernemen.

  • Je bent gedetailleerd onderzoekend en oplossingsgericht

  • Je volgt een studie als Facility Management /Bedrijfskunde/ Technische bedrijfskunde.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen.

  • Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren.

  • Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt.

data.title: Teamleider Inpak Vers Bereid
data.description:
Bij Crisp willen we beter eten mogelijk maken voor meer mensen. Goed eten begint bij goede producten. Maar pas als ze netjes zijn ingepakt, goed gelabeld en veilig verzegeld, kan een klant er ook echt van genieten.

Als Teamleider Inpak zorg jij ervoor dat elk product er perfect uitziet voordat het onze deur uitgaat. Samen met je team verpak je, controleer je en verdeel je alles over de juiste orders. Je hebt oog voor proces, kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid, en je houdt het tempo erin. Want een klant die zijn bestelling uitpakt en denkt "dat ziet er goed uit", dat is waar we het voor doen.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bedient de machines voor etiketteren, sealen en verpakken.

  • Je verpakt producten juist en zorgt voor de juiste etikettering.

  • Je controleert of de productkwaliteit aan de norm voldoet: het juiste etiket, de opmaak, het restzuurstofgehalte, de seal, metaaldetectie en meer.

  • Je zorgt dat verpakte producten goed worden verdeeld over de verschillende orders en bij de juiste order terechtkomen.

  • Je onderhoudt de apparatuur.

  • Je signaleert afwijkingen.

  • Je houdt de vereiste registraties bij: orderverdeling, metingen, productieaantallen, derving en meer.

  • Je houdt je strikt aan de veiligheidsvoorschriften.

  • Je denkt actief mee in teamvergaderingen over het verbeteren van het proces.

  • Je doet actief mee aan nieuwe initiatieven.

Dit ben jij

  • Je bent flexibel. Je kunt goed tegen verandering. Als je werk plotseling verandert, pas je je snel aan en vind je snel je weg in de nieuwe situatie.

  • Je bent een goede communicator. Je geeft duidelijk aan wanneer er iets is, en je doet dat ook echt. Je collega's weten wat je bedoelt, waar je mee bezig bent en wanneer je ergens tegenaan loopt.

  • Je bent nauwkeurig. Je werkt netjes, gestructureerd en volgens schema. Je registreert en noteert waar nodig.

  • Je bent een probleemoplosser. Loopt er iets niet zoals het moet? Dan loop jij er niet voor weg. Je verzamelt informatie, maakt een plan en overlegt waar nodig met je leidinggevende. Je herkent problemen op tijd en lost ze goed op.

  • Je bent technisch handig. Je kunt etiketteer- en sealmachines bedienen en begrijpt hoe productieprocessen werken.

  • Je bent kwaliteitsbewust. Je let nauwgezet op de kwaliteit van het product.

data.title: Productieleider Vers Bereid
data.description:
Als Productieleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken op de productieafdeling van Vers Bereid Door Crisp. Je stuurt op output, kwaliteit en veiligheid, maar vooral op structuur, samenwerking en verbetering. Je vertaalt wat klanten willen naar een productieplan dat haalbaar is. Je helpt je team het beste uit zichzelf te halen en bouwt met ons mee aan een productieafdeling die staat als een huis. Je bent de schakel tussen productie, techniek, kwaliteit, logistiek en kantoor. Zo houd je de kosten in de hand, zorg je dat we leveren wat we beloven en help je ons groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je vertaalt forecast en orders naar een realistisch productieplan en bewaakt het elke dag, op basis van wat klanten vragen en wie er beschikbaar is.

  • Je leidt de dagstart, verdeelt het werk en stelt prioriteiten. Bij vertraging of een storing stuur je bij.

  • Je loopt zichtbaar rond op de vloer en bent het aanspreekpunt voor operators, technische dienst en kwaliteitsmedewerkers.

  • Je stuurt teamleiders, operators en ondersteunende diensten aan op resultaat.

  • Je draagt een cultuur uit van veiligheid, discipline, openheid en verantwoordelijkheid, en bewaakt die.

  • Je zet samen met het team verbeteracties op en voert ze door: de OEE omhoog, omsteltijden korter, minder verspilling.

  • Je houdt de belangrijkste cijfers bij en analyseert ze: output, rendement, verspilling en afkeur. Je rapporteert aan de directie en doet voorstellen op basis van data.

  • Je borgt voedselveiligheid en kwaliteitsnormen. Je controleert de kwaliteitsregistraties, bewaakt hygiëne en HACCP en bereidt audits voor.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij audits, afwijkingen en escalaties.

  • Je regelt het operationele HR-werk: personeelsplanning, werving, inwerken, beoordelen en coachen van teamleden, zodat het team breed inzetbaar en betrokken blijft.

  • Je houdt overzicht over bestellingen van grondstoffen en verpakkingen, voorraad en capaciteit, en stemt af met inkoop, logistiek en andere afdelingen.

  • Je adviseert het management over investeringen, capaciteitsknelpunten en verbeterinitiatieven.

Dit ben jij

  • Je weet waar je het over hebt, maar nog belangrijker: je neemt mensen mee. Je bent zichtbaar, eerlijk, duidelijk en consistent.

  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen details op de vloer en de grotere bedrijfsdoelen. Je handelt snel en denkt structureel.

  • Stilstaan is niets voor jou. Je wilt processen, verspilling, doorlooptijd en prestaties steeds beter maken.

  • Jij laat niets door de vingers glippen. Je borgt standaarden samen met je team, kent je CCP's en grijpt in bij risico's.

  • Je werkt met dashboards, rapportages en planningsdata en neemt beslissingen op basis van feiten, niet op gevoel.

  • Je zorgt voor rust, ritme en eigenaarschap. Collega's weten waar ze aan toe zijn en groeien met jouw begeleiding.

  • Je weet dat de productie alleen goed draait als kwaliteit, techniek, planning en productie echt samenwerken. Jij bent die brug.

data.title: Grootzakelijk Strategie & Business Development stage
data.description:
Word een cruciaal onderdeel van de volgende groeifase van Crisp! Ben jij die strategische, commerciële en hands-on stagiair(e) die klaar is om een nieuwe markt voor Crisp te veroveren? We zoeken iemand die direct meebouwt aan de grootzakelijke markt. Je werkt samen met de Head of Food Service & Food Retail, kijkt mee achter de schermen bij de opbouw van een nieuwe business unit en draagt bij aan de omzetgroei van Crisp. Kom jij ons team versterken voor ten minste 5 maanden vanaf februari 2027?

Wat je gaat doen

data.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Dat kan alleen als al onze collega's gezond en met plezier aan het werk zijn. Als Casemanager Verzuim zorg jij ervoor dat we grip houden op verzuim. Je begeleidt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij verzuimvraagstukken, bewaakt de voortgang van dossiers en zorgt ervoor dat we volledig voldoen aan de Wet verbetering poortwachter.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bent eigenaar van het verzuimbeleid binnen Crisp. Je ontwikkelt, implementeert en verbetert een helder en effectief verzuim- en re-integratiebeleid voor zowel kantoor als Operations. Daarnaast initieer je preventie- en vitaliteitsprojecten om het verzuim organisatiebreed terug te dringen.

  • Je voert de regie over re-integratietrajecten binnen Spoor 1 en Spoor 2 en bewaakt alle wettelijke deadlines vanuit de Wet verbetering poortwachter, waaronder de Probleemanalyse, het Plan van Aanpak, de Eerstejaarsevaluatie en de WIA-aanvraag. Zo beperk je juridische en financiële risico's, zoals een loonsanctie van het UWV.

  • Je coacht en adviseert leidinggevenden bij verzuim-, frequent-verzuim- en drempelgesprekken en organiseert periodieke voortgangs- en sparringsessies. Binnen Crisp ben jij hét aanspreekpunt en de inhoudelijke expert op het gebied van verzuim, re-integratie en arbeidsongeschiktheid.

  • Je voert laagdrempelige voortgangs- en re-integratiegesprekken met zieke en herstellende collega's. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen die werkhervatting ondersteunen en adviseert managers over passende aanpassingen in bijvoorbeeld werkzaamheden, uren of de werkplek.

  • Je analyseert verzuimdata, zoals meldfrequentie, gemiddelde verzuimduur en trends, en vertaalt deze naar concrete actieplannen en heldere sturingsinformatie voor HR en het management. Op basis daarvan zet je preventieve initiatieven op, zoals trainingen, PMO's/PAGO's en vitaliteitsprogramma's.

data.title: Operational Lead
data.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Als Operational Lead zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat ons distributiecentrum in Amsterdam die belofte elke dag waarmaakt: duizenden boodschappen, op tijd en in topconditie bij onze klanten.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse operationele gang van zaken op de vloer. De Operationeel Manager stuurt jou iedere dag aan, en zal je ook begeleiden bij je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en je langetermijndoelen. 

  • Je geeft dagelijks operationeel leiding aan onze Team Leads en bent verantwoordelijk voor de operatie in en rondom het volledige warehouse, niet slechts één hal of afdeling.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat jouw team iedere dag gemotiveerd is en doelstellingen op efficiëntie, kwaliteit en veiligheid haalt.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Warehouse Managers om beleid te formuleren en zorgt voor innovatie in de processen. Je garandeert een goede implementatie van nieuwe initiatieven. 

  • Je zorgt met de Personeelsplanner voor een juiste planning op basis van financiële doelstellingen.

  • Je bent de spil van het warehouse. Je initieert onder andere vergaderingen, gesprekken en communicatie met andere afdelingen. En met jouw leidinggevende ervaring coach je collega-leidinggevenden van alle afdelingen.

Samen met het Warehouse Management draag je eindverantwoordelijkheid voor het warehouse. In het belang daarvan vind je het logisch om minimaal twee weekenden in de maand én twee ochtenden of avonden te werken. Met het Warehouse Management zorg je voor de best mogelijke aanwezigheid.

data.title: Warehouse Employee
data.description:
At Crisp, we are on a mission: making better-tasting food accessible to everyone, using the power of the shortest farm-to-table supply chain in a way you can be proud of. As a Warehouse Employee, you ensure that the ultra-fresh products from our suppliers are processed in the warehouse, and then pack them up so they can head out to the customer!

What you will be doing

As a Warehouse Employee, you work alongside your colleagues to ensure our customers' products are packed to perfection. You will be active throughout the day, with a varied set of tasks:

  • Scanning and collecting products in the warehouse, ensuring all groceries are neatly packed and chilled before they go out to our customers.

  • Restocking products, accurately sorting orders, and efficiently preparing shipments.

  • Part of our grocery selection is kept cold; you don't mind working regularly in a chilled environment of 3–6°C or in the freezer at -26°C.

About you

  • You are available at least 32 hours per week

  • You work with great attention to detail.

  • You are reliable.

  • You have good communication skills.

  • You enjoy physically active work.

  • You are currently living in (or close to) Amsterdam.

What we offer

  • An hourly wage up to €17.99.

  • A solid pension plan for the future via BPFL.

  • A fixed percentage of your salary to spend freely via Alleo (e.g., Zalando, Swapfiets, gift cards, courses).

  • A referral bonus when you bring in new "Crispies."

  • And... a substantial discount on your own Crisp groceries, because you deserve to eat well at home too.

Our selection process

Apply using the button below. The more you can share about yourself and your motivation to apply, the better.

At Crisp, we strive for an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of background, gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, or disability. We encourage applicants with diverse perspectives and backgrounds to apply and believe in equal opportunities for all. We value the unique contributions every employee brings and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and valued.

data.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager für Meta & Google Ads (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Diese Stelle richtet sich an Leute mit echter Erfahrung. Du steuerst seit mindestens drei Jahren eigenverantwortlich Werbebudgets auf Meta und Google und hast zuletzt mindestens 50.000 Euro im Monat selbst verantwortet. Wenn das auf dich zutrifft und du Lust auf Tempo und Verantwortung hast, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens, weil wir im Team am schnellsten sind.

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Performance unserer Kunden auf Meta und Google. Du entscheidest, wohin das Budget geht, was getestet wird und was skaliert. Du liest Zahlen so, dass du die Ursache findest und nicht nur das Symptom. Und du erklärst Kunden klar, was passiert und was als Nächstes kommt.

Konkret

  • Du steuerst Meta- und Google-Ads-Konten für E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands, von der Struktur bis zur Skalierung.
  • Du planst Budgets und Tests und entscheidest nach Profitabilität, nicht nur nach ROAS.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative-Team und sagst, welche Creatives deine Konten als Nächstes brauchen.
  • Du behältst Tracking und Datenqualität im Blick: Conversions API, Enhanced Conversions und GA4.
  • Du führst Kundengespräche auf Augenhöhe, auch wenn die Zahlen mal schlecht sind.
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools für Analyse, Reporting und Routine und gibst dein Wissen im Team weiter.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Steuerung von Meta und Google Ads.
  • Du hast zuletzt Monatsbudgets ab 50.000 Euro selbst verantwortet.
  • Du kennst E-Commerce- oder Leadgen-Konten aus der Praxis und kannst konkrete Ergebnisse nennen.
  • Du verstehst Attribution, Tracking und Unit Economics gut genug, um Zahlen zu hinterfragen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar, mit Kunden und im Team.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, weil du mit unseren Kunden sprichst.
  • Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du Verantwortung für Ergebnisse willst und nicht nur für Aufgaben.
  • du Entscheidungen mit Zahlen begründest.
  • du im Team besser wirst und andere besser machst.
  • du neugierig auf AI bist und sie im Alltag einsetzt.

Noch nicht passend ist die Rolle, wenn

  • du gerade erst ins Performance Marketing einsteigst.
  • du Kampagnen bisher vor allem nach Vorgabe umgesetzt hast.

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit TikTok oder Pinterest Ads.
  • Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo oder serverseitigem Tracking.
  • Agenturerfahrung mit mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig.

Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: eigene Kunden, eigene Budgets, eigene Entscheidungen.
  • Ein starkes Creative-Team im Haus, das liefert, was deine Konten brauchen.
  • Eigene AI-Workflows für Analyse und Reporting, damit du Zeit für Strategie hast.
  • Motiviertes High-Performance-Team, keine Politik, flache Hierarchien.
  • Spannende E-Commerce- und Leadgen-Brands (Food, Beauty, Lifestyle).
  • Benefitpaket mit Sachbezug, Wellpass, Mittagessen und Deutschlandticket.
  • Modernes, zentrales Office am Gärtnerplatz in München.
  • Team-Events, Workshops und Weiterbildungen.

Darauf schauen wir

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Wichtig sind uns dein Lebenslauf und deine Antworten im Bewerbungsformular. Dort fragen wir nach deiner Erfahrung, deinem Budget und einem Konto, das du selbst gesteuert hast. Antworte bitte mit Zahlen.

Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese drei Angaben bitte in deinen Lebenslauf: Jahre Erfahrung, zuletzt verantwortetes Monatsbudget und ein Konto mit Ergebnis.

So geht es danach weiter: Videocall, eine kurze Case-Aufgabe, ein Probetag bei uns im Office mit persönlichem Gespräch, dann unsere Entscheidung.

Wozu brauchen wir diese Stelle?

Die Luft- und Seefracht ist ein wichtiger Wachstumsbereich der ZUFALL logistics group. Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich.


Wie gestaltest du diese Stelle?

  • Du setzt die Vertriebsstrategie für den Bereich Luft- und Seefracht (Air & Sea) gemeinsam mit dem Senior Manager Air & Sea um
  • Du vermarktest unsere Dienstleistungen im Segment Luft- und Seefracht (LCL & FCL) im Bereich Import und Export

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren operativen Teams und internationalen Partnern zusammen


Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Du bringst einschlägige Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Luft- und Seefracht Dienstleistungen mit
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kundenumsätzen erzielt
  • Du schaffst es dich schnell in ein internationales Partnernetzwerk einzubringen 
  • Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Affinität „Türen zu öffnen“ und verstehst es dennoch als Team-Player zu agieren

data.title: Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d)
data.description:
Your Role & How we work

As our Engineer - Data & Platforms (m/f/d), you build and run the internal data products that our investment team, Quantitative Research and AI Engineering rely on every day: the pipelines, datasets, APIs and tools that turn a large and growing pool of financial and alternative data into something investors can act on. Our stack is Python, SQL, AWS, and Databricks.

You report to our Director of Engineering. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes to designing, building, and shipping. The team is small, so you take ownership of real products early, and you get a manager and colleagues invested in your growth into investment and data-platform topics. You work closely with Quantitative Research, AI Engineering, Product & Data, and the investment team, and we treat agentic AI as a default in how we build.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the internal products the investment and research teams use daily: data pipelines, datasets, APIs, and tooling, on top of our lakehouse and orchestration stack.

  • Work directly with the teams you build for: take in their requests, triage and prioritise them, protect the integrity and consistency of the product, and explain features and implementation trade-offs in clear, non-technical language.

  • Design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines, ETLs and integrations that handle complex financial and alternative datasets.

  • Bring and reinforce good engineering habits in the team: automated testing at several levels, CI/CD, pull requests and code review, and clear documentation.

  • Contribute to operational excellence: observability, monitoring, data quality, and secure data handling.

  • Use agentic AI across engineering work (coding, review, testing, debugging, documentation) and help the team push these practices forward.


The experience you bring

  • 3 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience, building and operating systems in production.

  • Strong Python and strong SQL, with clean, readable code and a good sense for data modelling.

  • Proven engineering discipline: you write tests (unit, integration, data quality), work with CI/CD, and use pull requests and code review as a matter of course, and you can show how you helped a team adopt them.

  • Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain what you built, why, and what it will and will not do, and you can say no constructively.

  • Hands-on use of AI across engineering functions, including frontier coding systems such as Claude Code and Codex, as a core part of how you work.

  • Genuine interest in investing, financial markets and data, and the ambition to grow into these topics.

  • Nice to have: Databricks or PySpark; data platform tooling such as orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar), lakehouse formats (Parquet, Delta, Iceberg) and AWS; experience with investment, financial or market data; building web frontends or APIs for internal tools; LLM systems in production.


2 reasons why you should not apply

  • You prefer fully specified tickets and no contact with users. Here the people you build for sit next to you, ask for things directly, and expect you to weigh in on what should be built and how.

  • You treat AI tooling as an occasional helper. We expect agentic AI to be a default in how you build, review, test, and ship, every day, not now and then.


Your mindset

  • You are a builder who loves to ship: pragmatic on trade-offs, careful on quality. You move fast, but fast does not mean sloppy.

  • You care about correctness, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability, and you leave codebases and teams better than you found them.

  • You are curious about how investment decisions are made and want to understand the data behind them, not just move it.

  • You see AI-powered development as a competitive advantage, not a novelty, and use agentic AI as a core part of how you work.

  • You communicate clearly on progress, trade-offs, and risk, and you own problems end-to-end.


What we offer

  • Work with petabytes of data and the most cutting-edge tools in and beyond asset management, with Day 1 ownership of challenging, varied work and a steep learning curve.

  • Become part of a unique success story in European asset management, alongside the most knowledgeable experts in the industry on one of the most consequential investment themes of the next decade.

  • A motivated, highly international team (15 nationalities) that gathers in person at our Berlin HQ and supports each other, with flat hierarchies and direct interaction with our management team and investors.

  • Visa sponsorship, relocation support, and a competitive compensation package with a meaningful variable component tied to fund performance.
