data.title: Senior Manager (Education)
data.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team


Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

Join us as a Senior Manager focused on the education sector to oversee a critical portfolio of projects, acting as the primary senior point of contact for education sector clients and internal Faculty teams. You will drive successful delivery, manage project commercial viability, and nurture strong customer relationships.

This is an entrepreneurial role where you will identify new business opportunities, develop proposals, and contribute to the growth of the business unit. You will lead and mentor cross-functional teams while acting as a strategic consultant, applying structured thinking to solve complex, real-world problems with Applied AI.

 
 

What you'll be doing:

  • Overseeing delivery of an end-to-end project portfolio focused on the education sector, ensuring high quality, timely completion, and managing commercial margins

  • Forming and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with customers, proactively managing expectations and carefully controlling project scope

  • Leading effective project meetings and ensuring clear, consistent communication of purpose and direction to both internal teams and clients

  • Identifying risks early, and leading teams to implement effective mitigating actions to ensure project success

  • Developing compelling proposals and sales pitches to generate new leads and identify opportunities for additional account growth

  • Mentoring and developing project team members’ skills, aligning their responsibilities with their professional growth

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and solutions, while articulating the value of AI in diverse business contexts

 
 

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve demonstrable success delivering complex technology projects from software engineering to AI products, preferably within the setting of consulting technology, or data-driven organisations.

  • You are adept at building and maintaining customer trust and translating between technical detail and core business challenges

  • You possess strong professional experience in the education sector. You have a high level of understanding of education policy and education technology, in the UK and internationally, with particular areas of specialism. You have an existing network within the education sector

  • You can provide a structured, analytical, and technical breakdown of problems, defining solutions that enhance customer workflows

  • You have demonstrated experience in the smooth delivery of excellent outcomes, using methodologies like Agile, Scrum, or Kanban

  • You are comfortable working in an ambiguous setting and have a clear understanding of how to structure commercials and pricing

  • You can identify and implement new business opportunities, including finding growth within accounts and visible support on external business development

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

data.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Lead (CDI), tu seras le responsable de l’organisation, de la structuration, et de la réussite de notre équipe Customer Success.

Solteo, c’est aujourd’hui 1000 entreprises d’installation qui utilisent la plateforme au quotidien.

Nos clients sont majoritairement des TPE / PME du bâtiment, parfois éloignées de la digitalisation, et qui passent le plus clair de leur temps au contact de leurs clients ou sur le chantier. D’où l’importance d’un support client efficace, et d’une communication adaptée, pour répondre à leurs questions, les former, et leur faire découvrir nos nouveaux services !

Nous avons découpé l’activité du pôle CS en 2 volets :

  • l’onboarding et le support : formation des utilisateurs, suivi des prises en main, résolution de tickets, remontées produit.

  • le suivi commercial : animation des renouvellements, anticipation du churn, identification des opportunités d’upsell, en lien avec l’équipe Sales.

Tu ne seras évidemment pas seul.e, et sera le manager d’une équipe de 2 personnes (pour commencer, et l’équipe suivra notre croissance) : 2 CSM, répartis sur le support et l’animation commerciale.

En tant que Customer Success Lead, tu seras owner des objectifs du pôle CS. A toi d’animer ton équipe et d’optimiser tes process, en lien avec le COO et la CEO.

Missions et responsabilités

  1. Support et onboarding :

    • Structurer le traitement des tickets, aujourd’hui traités de manière intuitive.

    • Industrialiser l’onboarding et l’activation des comptes, avec des formats efficaces, qui peuvent passer à l’échelle.

    • Qualifier les remontées terrain et les transmettre à l’équipe Product.

    • Assurer la promotion des nouvelles fonctionnalités et leur adoption.

  2. Commercial :

    • Piloter les renouvellements

    • Réduire le churn, via la mise en place d’un suivi de la santé des comptes, et des actions déclenchées sur ces signaux.

    • Détecter les opportunités d’upsell et faire le lien avec l’équipe Sales.

    • Apporter un soin particulier à nos quelques grands comptes ou partenaires importants.

  3. Transverse :

"Quand j’ai rejoint Alexandre et Manon pour créer Solteo, je cherchais un projet qui mettrait mes compétences tech au service de la transition énergétique et où je pourrais voir directement l’impact de mon travail sur le quotidien de nos utilisateurs. Depuis le début, on développe notre produit dans cette optique : avec une attention toute particulière aux feedbacks de nos installateurs. Chez Solteo, on veut continuer à accélérer le développement de notre produit sans que chaque sujet complexe repose sur le CTO.

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.

Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup, où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.

  1. Shaping & conception

Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.

  1. Delivery & impact

Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.

  1. Ownership & autonomie

Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre

Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.

Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.

🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap.

⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre

Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison.

data.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Notre mission

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ?

Le rôle

Pour accélérer notre croissance en France et à l’international, nous recherchons notre premier Sales Manager (futur VP Sales). Rattaché(e) directement à Manon (co-founder), qui porte ce rôle aujourd'hui, tu seras un(e) véritable builder, pour transformer un processus de vente encore artisanal en une machine performante, outillée et scalable, au service d'objectifs de croissance ambitieux.

Ce rôle allie une forte implication opérationnelle et une dimension stratégique : tu accompagnes l'équipe au plus près du terrain, tout en structurant notre organisation commerciale et en définissant notre stratégie de croissance.

L’équipe est actuellement composée de deux Account Executives et nous recrutons deux Business Developer.

Missions et responsabilités

1. Stratégie commerciale & Développement

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie Sales en France, puis orchestrer notre expansion sur des marchés européens prioritaires (harmonisation et adaptation du discours).

  • Construire un reporting fiable et prédictif : suivi des KPIs, forecast, vitesse de closing, cohérence du funnel.

  • Mettre en place et maîtriser la stack de prospection et les automatisations : CRM, séquences, scoring, workflows, alertes, playbooks (HubSpot, Apollo, Zapier, Make, etc.).

2. Management & Leadership

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences l’équipe Sales existante.

  • Installer des rituels qui font progresser l'équipe : points individuels, analyses de calls, coaching, challenges.

  • Anticiper, recruter et piloter les prochaines recrutements pour faire grandir l'équipe.

  • Montrer l’exemple et rester au contact du terrain : tu prospectes régulièrement et tu fais avancer ton propre pipe.

  • Expérience : 5 à 7 ans d’expérience globale, dont au moins 2 ans en tant que Lead Sales ou Sales Manager

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

  • Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records)

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

Nice to have:

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

data.description:
About Pelagon

Pelagon is a European defence technology company building Autonomous Maritime Interdiction systems. We bring together sensing, AI, software and maritime engineering to help protect critical infrastructure and maritime environments.

The role

We are looking for a very senior, hands-on software engineer to own the software running in Pelagon’s operations centre: our data infrastructure, processing services, internal tools and customer-facing applications.

You will architect the overall platform and build it with the team, from data ingestion and storage to machine-learning workloads, operational applications and deployment. You will be the technical interface between our embedded systems and AI teams, bringing their work together into a coherent, reliable system.

This role requires depth across software development, data engineering and DevOps. Our software must run on infrastructure operated by Pelagon or our customers, including self-hosted and on-premises environments. Robustness, operability and cybersecurity must be designed into the system from the outset.

What you will own

  • Software architecture and delivery. Define the architecture of our core services, APIs, internal tools and customer-facing applications. Make and document technical decisions, write production code and take responsibility for the system from design through operation.

  • Data infrastructure at scale. Build reliable ingestion, storage and retrieval for large volumes of sensor and operational data. Choose and operate databases and storage systems, design data models, and manage data quality, migrations, retention and performance.

  • Processing and machine-learning workflows. Build the infrastructure to schedule, execute and monitor data-processing and ML jobs. Handle dependencies, resource allocation, retries, reproducibility and failure recovery, working closely with the AI team to bring its workloads into production.

  • Deployment on infrastructure we control. Make the platform reproducibly deployable on Pelagon and customer infrastructure. Own infrastructure automation, software packaging, configuration, release pipelines, upgrades and rollback without depending on managed cloud services.

  • Reliability and operations. Establish observability, performance testing, capacity planning, backup and recovery. Diagnose production issues and build systems that recover predictably from interrupted connectivity, partial failures and faulty inputs.

  • Cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle. Build security into architecture, implementation, deployment and maintenance. Apply threat modelling, least-privilege access, authentication and authorisation, network isolation, secrets management, encryption and audit logging. Establish secure development practices, dependency and vulnerability management, patching and incident readiness.

  • Integration across teams. Define clear interfaces and data contracts with the embedded systems and AI teams. Own integration and end-to-end testing so devices, data pipelines, algorithms and applications operate as one system.

  • Engineering effectiveness. Set a high standard for code, testing, documentation and technical judgement. Mentor engineers and use AI-assisted development tools effectively to accelerate implementation, testing and investigation, while retaining rigorous review, security checks and control over sensitive code and data.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience building and operating robust, data-intensive production software, with architectural ownership across multiple components and teams.

  • Strong hands-on software development skills, with the ability to move from system design to implementation and difficult production debugging.

  • Deep experience with data ingestion, databases, storage systems and distributed processing, including the practical challenges of performance, consistency and scale.

  • A strong DevOps and systems background: Linux, networking, containers, orchestration, infrastructure as code and automated delivery.

  • Proven experience deploying and maintaining software on self-managed infrastructure, private infrastructure or customer premises, including operating the services that managed cloud platforms would otherwise provide.

  • Experience building or operating job orchestration and data-processing platforms, and integrating ML workloads into production systems.

  • Practical cybersecurity expertise and a record of applying it to production software and infrastructure. You can identify threats, make security trade-offs explicit and implement effective controls.

  • The judgement to choose maintainable solutions, anticipate failure modes and balance delivery speed with long-term reliability.

  • The ability to lead technically across disciplines, clarify ambiguous requirements and take ownership of the overall outcome.

  • Effective use of modern AI engineering tools, with the discipline to verify generated code and protect confidential information.

Useful experience

  • Sensor, time-series, streaming or geospatial data.

  • Compute-intensive workloads, GPU infrastructure or ML platform engineering.

  • Enterprise software deployed across multiple customer environments.

  • Systems with demanding availability, security or connectivity constraints.

  • Operator-facing applications and software connected to physical systems.

Why this role

You will have substantial ownership of the software foundation behind Pelagon’s operations, working directly with the founders, embedded systems engineers and AI team. Your architectural decisions and the code you ship will shape how the complete system is deployed, secured and operated.

We value demonstrated ownership: what you built, how it performed at scale, how you secured it and what you learned from operating it.

data.description:
About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, defense tech and healthtech.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.

Hexa Scale

Today, successful software companies have two ways to support and finance their growth: the VC path, and the self-financed profitable path. For software companies that can’t or do not want to bootstrap, but haven’t managed to stay permanently on hyper-growth, the VC path is a dead-end.

At Hexa Scale, we’re on a mission to solve this: offer a new alternative to fund and scale software companies towards exponential growth.

We believe that there are great software companies, still early stages in the 2-10m€ ARR range, that sit on amazing markets with a great product, but that require a few changes to unlock their potential.

We believe that by providing them with capital and strong operational leverage, we can put them on the right trajectory, towards category-leading exponential growth. Our full manifesto.

Your role is to help us find, select, invest in, and drive those companies.

Mission

You'll join a team of four (Quentin, Augustin, Thibault and Samuel). You’ll participate in the complete deal-flow cycle in order to make 2 or 3 successful deals a year.

What you'll do

Inbound deal flow

  • Contribute to our inbound engine and marketing initiatives: white papers, blog posts, campaigns and founder community events.

  • Screen every inbound lead and make sure founders hear back from us within hours.

Outbound deal flow

  • Build and maintain our AI-powered sourcing stack: company database, internal AI tools, data scraping and outreach sequences.

  • Qualify sourced companies and run outreach with a strong response rate, so that new opportunities come in every week.

  • Drive sourcing across the team, making sure everyone is accountable for pipeline volume.

Market research

  • Source and run calls with market experts outside our network, at scale.

Deal analysis & execution

  • Analyze targets in depth: business model, product, team, growth engine and business plan.

  • Build our own version of the business plan and financial model with the team to stress-test key assumptions and risks.

  • Write investment memos and present to the investment committee.

  • Analyze cap tables and contribute to deal structuring and term negotiation.

Portfolio & value creation

  • Monitor portfolio KPIs and track the progress of each transformation plan.

  • Support founders on ad-hoc value-creation projects (pricing, GTM, M&A).

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • 2–3 years in VC, growth equity, small-cap PE, tech M&A, or a comparable analytical role (strategy consulting, IB).

  • AI fluent - You’re at home with tools like Claude Code, Cowork, or OpenAI Codex, and you enjoy building your own AI applications to solve real-world problems

The position requires strong autonomy, political judgement, and the ability to translate complex regulatory developments into clear business and strategic implications for executive leadership.

Strategy & Executive Advisory

European Institutions Leadership

  • Lead engagement with EU institutions (European Commission, European Parliament, Council of the EU) and key ecosystem stakeholders.

Internal Alignment & Communication

data.title: Full-stack Software Engineer (Contract)
data.description:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

Context

You'll join a small, high-ownership engineering team building production systems that serve millions of users. We care deeply about code quality and clean architecture, and we intend to keep it that way as we scale.

As our freelance Full-stack Software Engineer, full-time, you will work inside the team like any of its engineers: same codebase, same standards, same ownership.

Your mission

Your goal is to build and ship the product that powers Lemrock's commerce infrastructure, with full ownership, from design to production. Concretely, you will:

  • Ship features end-to-end that reach millions of users, from data model and API design to the interface they interact with.

  • Scale and harden our backend as traffic, integrations, and product complexity grow.

  • Shape the architecture of the codebase: enforce clean boundaries, maintain modularity, and make decisions that compound as the team scales.

  • Move fast across the stack (backend, frontend, infra, data), wherever the highest-impact work is on any given week.

From day one

  • You push your first code to production within your first days, then ship every week

  • You write excellent, well-tested code the team can build on

  • You are reliable: when you take something on, it gets delivered

Candidate profile

  • Strong academic background, proven professional track record, or hands-on entrepreneurial experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript

  • Experience with structured backend architectures (DDD, hexagonal, or similar)

  • Has owned features end-to-end: data model → API → frontend → deployment

  • Uses AI coding tools every day (Cursor, Claude Code)

  • Thrives in ambiguity and 0-to-1 environments: ex-founders or entrepreneurial mindsets are a strong fit

  • Professional proficiency in French & English

Tech stack

Core (required)

  • TypeScript, NestJS, React

  • PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Docker

  • Clean architecture patterns (hexagonal, ports & adapters)

Bonus (appreciated but not required)

  • GCP (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), Terraform

  • Vector databases, embeddings, LLM integrations

  • Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS

  • TanStack (Router, Query, Table), shadcn/ui, Tailwind, Vite

  • Durable workflows (Inngest, Temporal)

The mission

  • Freelance, full-time, starting ASAP

  • 3 months minimum, extended to 6 or 12 months when it works well

  • For the right person, the mission can turn into a permanent role

Why join us

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

  • Work directly with an experienced team: two repeat YC founders who've scaled product & tech before, a former strategy/innovation director (10 years in the sector), and ex-strategy consultants (McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG)

  • Be part of the next structural shift of the web: agentic interfaces

  • Own mission-critical topics, grow fast, and shape the company's future trajectory

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

data.title: AI Support Engineer Lead
data.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

 

At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator: people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?”

 

As our AI Support Engineering Lead, you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales.

 

You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same.

 

We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow.

 

What you'll do

 

Build the AI systems that do the work

  • Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds.

  • Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach.

  • Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback.

  • Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount.

  • Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means.

 

Run support when the systems fall short

  • Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will.

  • Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it.

  • Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers.

  • Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal.

 

Bridge customer pain to product improvements

  • Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it.

  • Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations.

  • Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation.

 

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

 

Aptitude

  • Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch.

  • High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace.

  • AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing.

  • People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you.

  • Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers.

  • Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring.

 

Attitude

  • Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard.

  • Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience.

  • Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it.

  • Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate.

  • Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined.

  • Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team.

 

Agency

  • High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap.

  • Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction.

  • Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences.

  • Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same.

 

Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist.

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive compensation based on level and experience

    • 100,000€ - 160,000€

  • Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Health benefits for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc.

  • Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices

  • Regular team events and off-sites

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

data.title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
data.description:
À propos de Lifen

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique.

Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France.

Notre équipe

L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche.

Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données.

Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering.

C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus.

Ce que tu feras chez nous

Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation.

Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à :

  • Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne.

  • Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume.

  • Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe.

  • Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement.

  • Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées.

  • Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche.

Ce que nous attendrons de toi

Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production.

Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle.

À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois.

Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours :

  • Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up, dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire.

  • Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence, idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients.

  • Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique.

Nous attendons également :

  • Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI.

  • Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré.

  • Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering.

  • Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables.

Nice-to-have

  • Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche.

  • Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD.

  • Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé.

  • Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé.

Ta manière de travailler

Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions.

Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place.

Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact.

Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes.

Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté.

Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique.

Process de recrutement

Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance.

Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses.

Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs.

Compensation: €65K – €75K

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Kernel Software Engineer, you own the low-level software platform that sits between our hardware and the flight application on our ground control stations. You work across the Linux kernel, board support and a custom Android build, so that every control, display and data link works reliably in the field. You are the bridge between our hardware and application teams, taking a new product line from board bring-up to mass production.

Responsibilities

  • Bring up, configure and maintain the Linux kernel on our hardware, including device tree, drivers and security patches.

  • Customize and maintain our Android build, covering system services, permissions, boot sequence and OTA updates.

  • Integrate controls, display, touch, battery and radio modules, and expose them cleanly to the application layer.

  • Ensure robust, low-latency SBUS and MAVLink data flows between the controller, the radio and the drone.

  • Debug hardware and software issues alongside electronics and mechanical engineers, using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and UART/JTAG.

  • Define flashing, provisioning, factory test and release procedures with the production team.

  • Work with QGroundControl engineers and QA to validate system behavior on real hardware.

  • Join field tests and flight sessions to validate your work in real conditions.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in embedded software development.

  • Strong command of the Linux kernel (configuration, device tree, drivers, debugging) and of C; C++ is a plus.

  • Hands-on background customizing AOSP, from HALs and system services to the build system.

  • Comfortable at the hardware boundary: UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, USB, display and touch controllers.

  • Exposure to drones or robotics, including MAVLink or PX4/ArduPilot, is a plus.

  • Hands-on, autonomous and pragmatic, with curiosity about hardware and the ability to learn quickly.

  • Professional English for technical documentation and international collaboration.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Account Executive 🇫🇷 (Small Businesses)
data.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Small Businesses Team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 3 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role;

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B1-C0 level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

Our team of 700+ people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🤘 How we do it ?

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, mission above all else

  • Member & customer-led: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density

  • Distributed ownership: everyone owns their decisions and results

  • Radically transparent: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow

  • Bold contrarians: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

  • Disciplined execution: decisive action with compounding focus

  • Fight for simplicity: high-impact processes, smart frugality


⭐️ Senior Brand Designer at Alan 

Our Brand at Alan is precious to us, and is evolving as we grow!

As part of the Design team, the Brand designer plays a large role in cementing our brand, creates visually compelling assets to support our messaging, and uses their experience to grow a strong brand design practice.

Your missions will include:

  • Define and evolve Alan's visual identity and brand systems, and make sure they hold up across every touchpoint.

  • Own briefs end-to-end: understand the business problem, help shape the strategy, then explore, prioritize, and ship the solution.

  • Create and art-direct campaigns and assets across the web, including our landing pages, email, advertising, and social channels, bringing the brand to life through art direction, motion, and video.

  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Brand to translate business objectives into visuals that convert.

  • Extend brand design work into our Health & Prevention area, alongside our core Marketing & Brand responsibilities.

  • Scale production to deliver high volumes of assets without losing quality or brand consistency.

  • Leadership & mentoring:
    - You lead through influence by shaping roadmaps, aligning stakeholders around well-reasoned proposals and trade-offs, and proactively communicating progress and plans.
    - You raise the bar for others by coaching and mentoring designers and non-designers, and helping Alaners grow through thoughtful feedback and technical or creative leadership.

Our current Design priorities 🌟

Our Design community red thread is to grow our brand design practice and ensure consistency in order to build an established and memorable brand.

To succeed in this mission, we currently:

  • Consolidating and scaling our visual identity across every touchpoint: web, email, ads, social, and increasingly our own landing pages, where brand expression and conversion design meet.

  • Growing our motion and video capability: it's a big plus for this role, not a nice-to-have.

  • Creating impactful physical and event experiences that bring the brand to life beyond screens.

  • You are at the cutting edge of AI-enabled design and creative workflows, actively experimenting with emerging models and tools and turning them into practical ways to improve the quality, speed, and impact of your work.

  • Extending brand identity into our Health & Prevention area, alongside our core Marketing & Brand responsibilities.

  • Shaping how Alan's mascot and visual universe show up, used deliberately, not everywhere.

If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit 👯‍♀️

  • 4+ years' experience, ideally in a product company or startup, we're hiring at a Senior level.

  • You are fluent in English.

  • You are an experienced user of design software (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) and motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere is a plus).

  • Comfortable with generative AI tools, and keen to experiment with new approaches as you push creative boundaries within brand guidelines.

  • A deep understanding of growth, campaigns, and conversion-focused design, with a strong sense of how visuals drive business outcomes.

  • Able to scale and deliver high volumes of assets while keeping quality and brand consistency intact.

  • Understands business objectives and audiences, and can turn a brief into impactful visuals autonomously.

  • Experienced designing for online platforms: websites, social media, email marketing, and display ads.

  • You excel at communicating and articulating creative choices in a compelling way.

  • You're structured, and understand that goals and constraints need to be clarified before executing.

  • A portfolio showing real product/company work (not just agency spec work), illustration capability, and range across formats.

  • Based in (or open to relocating to) Paris (preferred), or Marseille, Bordeaux, Madrid, Brussels, or Barcelona.

Nice to have:

🤹 Operations at Alan

Behind Alan's performance lies an Operations team that is anything but back-office. At Alan, Ops is a strategic function: we define the vision, build the systems, and own the outcomes that make our insurance and healthcare products work at scale.

As a Senior Ops & Product Builder, you will own some of the most critical and ambiguous challenges in the company. You will shape strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and build solutions with lasting impact on Alan's P&L and member experience.

You’ll be joining 80+ talented, committed, passionate Ops team members working globally on all our services. You’ll be among the team mates structuring this community.

⭐️ The challenges

We are looking for driven professionals and entrepreneurs with a strong operational background to disrupt the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare. Our goal is to delight our members everywhere as we keep on scaling and building new services in France and internationally.

The job description is simple: you set the vision, make the hard calls, and own the outcome.

Here are some examples of missions our team is covering that you could lead:

  • Saving millions through fraud detection: Building a detection capability with no playbook. Owning make-vs-buy decisions on tooling, balancing precision against member experience at scale, and managing the external surface. Partner negotiations, industry lobbying, and ecosystem-level fraud strategy.

  • Building a global recovery engine: Establishing a billing monitoring framework to identify gaps early on. Then building assets & partnerships to drive costs down : designing a global recovery system that adapts to local legislation to support Alan’s expansion. With millions invoiced every month and high growth, the impact on P&L is direct.

  • Scaling psychotherapy online sessions: Defining the operating model from scratch, making hard resourcing decisions under uncertainty, managing quality at scale, and driving international replication. Today: 80,000 sessions were delivered & 93% of users report reduced stress.

data.title: SMB Go-to-Market Lead
data.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for an SMB Go-To-Market Lead to own how Photoroom wins established eCommerce merchants doing €500K to tens of millions in GMV (gross merchandise value, i.e., annual online sales).

You come from the eCommerce world. You know where these merchants spend their time, which platforms they run on (Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and the agencies and apps around them), and which channels actually move them. You've already acquired merchants at this scale, and you've done it with campaigns people talked about.

This is a lead role. You'll ship campaigns yourself every month, and you'll lead a team of 2 GTM managers focused on dedicated personas. This is a marketing lead role for someone who still loves making the work, not a manager who has stopped shipping.

Compensation: €80,000 – €110,000 + BSPCE

Location: Paris, in-office 3 days per week

About the Role

  • Own SMB merchant acquisition and revenue - Set the GTM strategy for established eCommerce brands and own the numbers behind it: new merchant acquisition and conversion to paid users. Report on them monthly, and decide where the next euro goes across your channels.

  • Build the B2B channels we don't have yet - Set up and scale outbound, partnerships (eCom platforms, app ecosystems, agencies, marketplaces), in-person events, and LinkedIn. Find which ones work for merchants at €500K+ GMV, prove them, then turn them into repeatable playbooks.

  • Create campaigns people talk about - Concept, write, and ship launch and brand campaigns that spread across eCommerce communities and social feeds. You have the creative idea and know how to distribute it.

  • Stay hands-on - Personally run at least one major campaign or channel bet each quarter, end to end. Set the bar for the team by doing the work, not just reviewing it.

  • Lead and grow a team of 2, two GTM managers, each owning a merchant persona. Set clear goals, coach weekly, hire well as the team grows.

  • Be the voice of the merchant - Turn what you hear from merchants, partners, and the market into positioning, messaging, and input for Product.

  • Orchestrate campaigns across Marketing - Work hand in hand with our Paid User Acquisition, PR, and SEO/GEO teams. Bring them into every campaign from the brief, so paid, earned, and organic efforts land together and amplify each other.

  • Measure everything - Track impact from first touch to paying merchant, report on CAC (customer acquisition cost) and payback by channel, and kill what doesn't work fast.

About you

You know eCommerce merchants from the inside, and you have the results and the campaigns to show for it.

  • 8+ years in GTM, product marketing (PMM), or marketing in the eCommerce industry - At an eCom platform, a SaaS for merchants, a marketplace, an agency, or a fast-growing DTC brand.

  • A track record of acquiring merchants at scale - You've acquired eCommerce merchants at scale, including established brands doing €500K to tens of millions in GMV. You can walk us through the numbers. You know the platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Etsy…), their app stores and partner programs, the agencies and the communities where merchants make decisions.

  • Proven in B2B channels - You've personally run outbound, partnerships, in-person events, or LinkedIn programs that generated pipeline.

  • Strong creative background - You've led campaigns that went viral or became the reference in their category. You have taste, you can write, and you can brief and judge creative work.

  • A player-coach who still ships - You're excited to lead a small team and make them better, while still doing the work yourself. Prior management experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Data-driven - You set up tracking and attribution, read the numbers yourself, and make calls on them.

  • Fluent in modern AI tools - Like every great marketer today, you use AI in your daily work to go faster.

  • Autonomous with proactive transparency - You share plans early, keep the team informed, and communicate openly so everyone stays aligned.

  • Fluent English (we exclusively work in English)

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Bonus points

  • You've worked at or with Shopify, an eCom platform, or a top app in its ecosystem.

  • You have an existing network of eCom founders, agencies, and partners in Europe or the US.

  • You've built or grown a community of merchants or creators.

  • You've worked in a fast-growing AI or product-led growth (PLG) company, where users sign up and buy without talking to sales.

What you’ll ship in your first 90 days

  • A channel plan for established merchants. Which of outbound, partnerships, events, and LinkedIn we test first, the target for each, and the budget.

  • A first outbound engine. A targeted list of €500K+ GMV brands, persona-tailored sequences, and at least 5K merchants reached through it.

  • A partnership with a platform, app, or agency. Co-marketing that puts Photoroom in front of thousands of merchants.

Benefits

  • Regular team gatherings, including in-person onboarding in Paris (1–2 weeks), yearly company offsite, team retreats, and quarterly in-person meetings

  • 25 days annual leave + RTT and local public holidays

  • Competitive equity package with BSPCE

  • €1,000 annual learning and development budget

  • Private health insurance

  • Access to personalized mental health support via MokaCare

  • Sports and cultural activities reimbursement

  • Relocation support (up to €10k) for those choosing to move to France (visa + housing support)

Note: Visa sponsorship and relocation support are only available for roles based in France.

Hiring Process

  1. Screening call with Talent Manager (30 min)

  2. Technical interview with Hiring Manager (45 min)

  3. Take-home assignment and live review with the team (45 min)

  4. Culture fit interviews and meet the team (~3h total)

  5. Reference check and offer

Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
