data.title: Head of Crypto
data.description:
About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

  • Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

  • Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

  • Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

  • Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

  • Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

  • Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

  • Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

  • Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up.

  • Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure.

  • Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework.

  • Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team.

  • Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

  • Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!


Learn more about us

Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here.

data.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

  • Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

  • Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

  • Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

  • Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites.

Your Background

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project.

  • Strong coding skills in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2.

  • Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged.

  • Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo.

  • Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

data.title: System Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a System Engineer, you will own the architecture, system definition and implementation of one of our robotic systems — from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with project managers and technical leads to translate mission needs into system-level designs, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, and ensure overall system performance, robustness, and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • System Architecture: Transform system requirements into architectures solutions.

  • Technical Coordination: Lead cross-functional design across mechanical, electrical, software, GNC, and ML teams.

  • Trade-Off & Design Analysis: Conduct feasibility studies, trade-off analyses, and system-level simulations to guide technical choices.

  • Integration & Validation: Oversee system integration, prototyping, and validation, ensuring performance targets are achieved.

  • System Reviews: Drive design and architecture reviews, maintaining consistency between requirements, design, and testing.

  • Continuous Improvement: Implement processes to enhance requirements traceability, system documentation, and validation workflows.


Candidate Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in system engineering within robotics, aerospace, or defense sectors.

  • MSc in Engineering (any field); PhD is a plus.

  • Proven experience leading full system lifecycles (concept → prototype → validation).

  • Strong background in system architecture, requirements engineering, and trade-off analysis.

  • Broad engineering culture with understanding of mechanical, electrical, and embedded systems.

  • Experience coordinating multi-disciplinary teams and managing technical interfaces.

  • Rigorous, structured, and mission-driven mindset with strong analytical skills.

  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities.

  • Bonus: Experience with UAS or defense systems.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.description:
Kandou is redefining AI infrastructure through innovative interconnect technologies that significantly reduce power consumption while maintaining high bandwidth and ultra-low latency. Our mission is to make AI systems more scalable, efficient, and accessible.

For our Headquarter in Saint-Sulpice, we are actively looking for a Junior/Graduate Accountant.

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join the Finance team as a Junior/Graduate Accountant. This is an entry-level role, ideal for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to day-to-day accounting and finance operations. This is a global role: you will support transactions, postings, and reconciliations across Kandou's multiple legal entities and countries (including Switzerland, the US, UK, Germany, India, and Taiwan), not just the Swiss entity — so exposure to multi-currency and multi-entity accounting is part of the job.   • Support the AP/AR cycle, including invoice coding, approvals tracking, and vendor queries

  • Assist with the monthly close process under supervision (accruals, prepayments, basic schedules)

  • Help maintain accurate, organized supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes

  • Support ad hoc finance projects and administrative tasks as assigned by the team

Required Education

Required Experience

  • No prior professional experience required; internships or academic projects in accounting/finance are a plus

Required Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers

  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions and escalating issues

What We Offer

  • Direct mentorship from experienced accounting and finance professionals

data.description:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

  • A utility business with a strong free tier

  • Experience with high-volume consumer tools

  • Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate.

Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact!

Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.

Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values.

Our Benefits

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home, our offices are pet-friendly

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

🍻 BBQs, game nights, meetups in the Swiss Alps, or in kayaks on Lake Zurich—we’re serious about great coffee, karaoke, and Mario Kart, too!

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

data.title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
data.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. data.title: Customer Retention stage
data.description:
Crisp is een van de snelst groeiende scale-ups in Europa. Klantretentie speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een allround stagiair die ons kan ondersteunen bij het continue activeren van onze klanten. Bij Crisp bevind je je in een uitdagende omgeving met veel kansen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Kom jij ons team versterken voor ten minste 5 maanden vanaf februari 2027?

Wat je gaat doen

Als Customer Retention stagiair krijg je een uniek inzicht in de wereld van consumentenpsychologie en de rol van marketing in consumentengedrag. Je ondersteunt de campagne & promotion specialists in ons Retentie-team bij een breed scala aan marketingtools, van promoties en prijzen tot heractivatie- en nieuwsbriefcampagnes. Je neemt volledig deel aan het Retentie-team en werkt nauw samen met onze Campaign- & Promotion Specialists, en onze Head of Retention.

Enkele voorbeelden van wat je gaat doen:

  • End-to-end uitvoering van e-mailcampagnes; van het aanvragen en selecteren van de juiste inhoud tot het instellen en uitvoeren van de technische details en het analyseren van de resultaten.

  • 360-graden-uitvoering van onze promotiecampagnes, inclusief het selecteren van de optimale promotieproducten, het afstemmen met het forecast- en buyerteam, het creëren en verzenden van communicatie via meerdere kanalen, en het analyseren van resultaten.

  • Het opzetten van A/B-testen om de effectiviteit van onze content en promoties te verbeteren.

Dit ben jij 

  • Je zit in je laatste jaar of bent net afgestudeerd aan een HBO-opleiding of universitaire bacheloropleiding.

  • Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar voor ten minste 5 maanden.

  • Je hebt een passie voor consumentenpsychologie, marketing en promotie.

  • Je hebt ervaring in het coördineren van projecten.

  • Je hebt oog voor detail en je bent resultaatgericht.

  • Je hebt (net als de rest van ons team) een passie voor duurzaam en lekker eten.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen.

  • Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren.

  • Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt.

  • Een gratis lunch van Crisp.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. 

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

data.title: Assistent Teamleider Warehouse
data.description:
Assistent Teamleider Warehouse

Elke dag worden onze boodschappen met veel zorg ingepakt en klaargemaakt voor bezorging. Als Assistent Teamleider in ons warehouse in Amsterdam stuur je een team van verschillende Warehouse Medewerkers aan om ervoor te zorgen dat onze processen tot in de puntjes worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij los je moeiteloos problemen op die op je pad komen.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Assistent Teamleider geef je leiding aan 10-20 medewerkers, coacht hen bij hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden en zorgt dat ze efficiënt en veilig werken. Daarnaast bewaak je de productiviteit van je team. Je weet wie je wanneer een compliment moet geven, maar bent ook niet bang mensen aan te spreken als ze niet doen wat jij van ze verwacht. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je houdt overzicht over de dagelijkse processen.

  • Je koppelt problemen (en bijbehorende oplossingen) moeiteloos door aan de Teamleiders.

  • Je motiveert Warehouse Medewerkers en zorgt dat zij hun werk met plezier en op tijd afkrijgen.

  • Je kijkt kritisch naar de processen en waar deze verbeterd kunnen worden.

Onze Assistent Teamleiders houden van aanpakken. Omdat ze veel aan de slag zijn op de vloer zien ze snel wat er heel goed gaat op de vloer, maar ook wat er beter kan. Dit communiceren ze met de desbetreffende medewerkers, of dit nu Orderpickers, Teamleiders, of Operational Leads zijn. data.title: Warehouse Medewerker
data.description:
Op zoek naar een bijbaan waarin je lekker in beweging blijft en je dagelijks duizenden mensen blij maakt met fijn verpakte boodschappen? Solliciteer nu!

Wat ga je doen?

Als medewerker in ons warehouse zorg jij er met je collega's voor dat al onze klanten hun lievelingsproducten in perfecte staat thuis krijgen. Je bent de hele dag lekker in beweging, en je verantwoordelijkheden zijn afwisselend.

  • Je scant en verzamelt producten in het warehouse en zorgt ervoor dat alle boodschappen netjes worden verpakt en gekoeld, voordat ze naar onze klanten gaan.

  • Je helpt met het controleren van de kwaliteit van alle groente en fruit, zodat we alleen het beste van het beste bezorgen.

  • Als onze leveranciers hun spullen komen brengen, ontvang je hen en controleer je de vracht. Vervolgens zorg je dat alles op de juiste plek in het warehouse terechtkomt.

Wat zijn de functie-eisen?

  • Minimaal 16 jaar oud

  • Nederlands goed begrijpen en spreken

  • Je vindt het niet erg om regelmatig in de koeling (3-6 graden) of vriezer (-20 graden) te werken

  • Woonachtig in Amsterdam

En wat zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden?

  • Mogelijkheid tot flexibele uren óf het werken van vaste uren tot een maximum van 40 per week

  • Een uurloon tussen de €10,45 en €17,99 inclusief vakantierechten en vakantietoeslagen

  • Flexibele shifttijden tussen 05:00 en 23:00 uur

  • Toeslagen van 25% tot 35% tijdens de avond- en weekenduren

  • Zelf bepalen hoeveel en wanneer je werkt

  • 20% korting op je Crisp boodschappen

  • Een goed geregeld pensioen voor later

  • Een persoonlijk budget voor yoga, sport, en andere leuke activiteiten zoals bijvoorbeeld Ticketmaster, Pathé, Felyx en Swapfiets

Hoe ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit?

  • Zodra je het sollicitatieformulier hebt ingevuld zullen onze Recruiters dit in behandeling nemen.

  • Als het een match is zullen ze telefonisch contact met je opnemen om je wat beter leren kennen. Dit gesprek zal rond de 10 minuten duren - houd je telefoon in de gaten!

  • Hierna nog steeds enthousiast? Dan spreken we af voor een sollicitatiegesprek op het warehouse, waarvan je in het beste geval met een aanbod weer naar huis gaat

data.title: PCB/RF Design Engineer
data.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Join us as a RF/PCB Design Engineer to drive the physical realization of our next-generation 3D quantum hardware architecture - hardware that operates from room temperature down to millikelvin conditions inside a dilution refrigerator. You will own the design of critical microwave components, create high-density cryo-compatible PCB layouts, and build novel packaging solutions for large-scale QPUs. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll also help streamline our development by embedding design processes into automated workflows.

What you'll be doing

  • Component & Mechanical Design: Design critical electromechanical components that form the chief interface of our QPUs and TWPAs. You will work as part of the packaging team and interface closely with the Product design team.

  • Precision Engineering: Utilise CAD to design PCBs, silicon chip layout and PCB-to-chip interconnect within the vertical VIO architecture.

  • RF/Microwave Design: Solve complex challenges related to insertion loss, impedance matching, and cross-talk at the PCB and package levels.

  • Cryogenic Integration & Testing: Design for and validate performance across the full temperature range from room temperature to millikelvin — accounting for thermal cycling, differential contraction, and material behavior at cryogenic temperatures, and running cooldown/characterization tests in dilution refrigerators.

Your Profile

  • Education: BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering with a focus on PCB design, layout, and RF/Microwave Engineering.

  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on PCB design experience utilizing tools such as KiCAD, Altium Designer, and Cadence to deliver high-quality board designs. Experience with diverse materials such as cofired ceramic boards (LTCC, HTCC) is a plus.

  • Cryogenic Applications: Hands-on experience designing or testing hardware for cryogenic environments - e.g., dilution refrigerators, cryostats, or low-temperature RF/microwave systems.

  • Core EE Fundamentals: Solid understanding of developing schematics, electro-mechanical interfaces, RF layout trades, temperature dependent behavior, shielding, signal integrity, and impedance analysis.

Nice to Have:

  • Packaging & Interconnects: Background in high-density interconnects, high frequency flex interconnects, 3D packaging, or advanced integration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with superconducting technologies is a strong plus.

  • RF Characterization: Practical experience with RF testing and measurements using VNA and related laboratory equipment.

data.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. As Laboratory Operations & Safety Officer, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of QuantWare’s laboratories while helping build the operational foundations for our expanding R&D facilities, including our new semiconductor cleanroom.

Working closely with the Health & Safety Officer, R&D, Facilities and Operations teams, you will establish scalable laboratory and cleanroom support processes, ensuring our facilities remain safe, compliant and operationally efficient.

As QuantWare continues to scale, many laboratory and cleanroom procedures, operational standards and safety processes are still under development. You will own the creation, implementation, and continuous improvement of these procedures, supporting both current laboratory operations and the commissioning of our new cleanroom facilities.

You will also support the Health & Safety Officer in implementing laboratory and cleanroom safety programmes, coordinating the RI&E (Risk Inventory & Evaluation), developing safe working procedures and ensuring compliance with applicable EHS requirements.

What you'll be doing

  • Coordinate laboratory and cleanroom operations, including procurement, inventory management, asset tracking, storage, logistics, equipment calibration, maintenance, qualification and vendor coordination, ensuring laboratories remain operational and compliant.

  • Develop, implement and continuously improve laboratory and cleanroom operational procedures, work instructions, documentation and support processes, establishing scalable ways of working as QuantWare continues to grow.

  • Support the Health & Safety Officer in developing and maintaining the laboratory and cleanroom EHS management system, including coordinating the RI&E (Risk Inventory & Evaluation), hazard identification, workplace inspections, risk assessments and implementation of preventive and corrective actions.

  • Develop and implement safe working procedures for laboratory and cleanroom activities, including the safe handling, storage and emergency response for hazardous chemicals, specialty gases and other high-risk processes, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and industry best practices.

  • Manage laboratory chemical safety programmes, including chemical inventories, Safety Data Sheet (SDS) administration, chemical compatibility assessments, permit-to-work support, waste management and environmental compliance activities.

  • Support internal and external audits, inspections and regulatory compliance, maintain EHS documentation, monitor safety performance indicators and contribute to the continuous improvement of QuantWare's safety culture.

  • Coordinate laboratory and cleanroom onboarding, participate in laboratory and cleanroom related safety training activities, maintain training and competency records, and support the BHV/Emergency Response Organisation to ensure personnel and emergency preparedness programmes remain effective.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.

  • 5+ years experience in Cleanroom facilities Operations, EHS, QHSE, Laboratory Operations or a similar technical environment.

  • Experience developing and implementing laboratory or cleanroom operational procedures and work instructions.

  • Experience conducting or coordinating RI&E (Risk Inventory & Evaluation), risk assessments, workplace inspections and incident investigations.

data.title: Facilities Engineer
data.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Als Facilities Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en betrouwbaar draaiende houden van de facilitaire installaties die cruciaal zijn voor onze cleanroomomgeving. Deze omvatten, maar zijn niet beperkt tot, luchtbehandelingssystemen, gaskasten, stikstofgeneratie, perslucht, ultrapuur water (UPW) en chemische toevoersystemen.

De nadruk binnen deze rol ligt op het waarborgen van de continuïteit en betrouwbaarheid van kritieke nutsvoorzieningen (utilities). In het bijzonder moeten het ventilatie-/luchtbehandelingssysteem en de UPW-installatie continu operationeel en betrouwbaar blijven. Jouw werk is essentieel bij het opschalen naar steeds complexere systemen en het waarmaken van de belofte van quantum computing.

Wat je gaat doen

  • Dagelijks monitoren, inspecteren en onderhouden van cleanroomgerelateerde installaties;

  • Zorgen dat het luchtbehandelings-/ventilatiesysteem continu operationeel blijft;

  • Monitoren van de cleanroom- en apparatuurcondities, zoals luchtkwaliteit, drukverschillen, temperatuur en luchtvochtigheid, stikstofgeneratie, perslucht en speciale gassystemen;

  • Controleren en onderhouden van de ultrapuur water- / UPW-installatie;

  • Ondersteunen van chemische toevoersystemen;

  • Snel en effectief identificeren, analyseren en oplossen van technische problemen;

  • Uitvoeren en coördineren van preventief onderhoud;

  • Deelnemen aan storings- en calamiteitenprocedures (emergency response) en het bieden van technische ondersteuning tijdens uitval van nutsvoorzieningen;

  • Coördineren van en toezicht houden op externe leveranciers en servicecontractanten.

  • Het bijhouden van technische documentatie, onderhoudslogboeken en servicerapporten;

  • Het naleven van alle veiligheidsprocedures en cleanroomprotocollen;

  • Bijdragen aan verbeteringen op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en efficiëntie.


Jouw profiel

  • Een afgeronde technische opleiding op MBO-4 of HBO-niveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek, installatietechniek, procestechnologie of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied;

  • Ervaring met technische installaties in een industriële, hightech- of cleanroomomgeving;

  • Kennis van HVAC- / luchtbehandelingssystemen;

  • Ervaring met nutsvoorzieningen (utilities) zoals perslucht, stikstof, proceswater of ultrapuur water;

  • Ervaring met gassystemen of chemische toevoersystemen is een sterke pré;

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en veiligheidsbewuste manier van werken;

  • Sterke probleemoplossende vaardigheden en een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

  • Bereidheid om te werken volgens strikte cleanroom- en veiligheidsprocedures;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in de samenwerking met collega's, leveranciers en aannemers.


Taaleisen
Voor deze functie is het Nederlands de belangrijkste voertaal op de werkvloer.
Daarnaast beheers je de Engelse taal goed en kun je je zelfverzekerd uitdrukken in woord en geschrift. Technische documentatie, communicatie met leveranciers en handleidingen van apparatuur zijn namelijk in het Engels.

  • RF Characterization: Practical experience with RF testing and measurements using VNA and related laboratory equipment.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Quantum Design Engineer in our R&D team, you’ll be at the heart of advancing the performance and scalability of superconducting quantum processors. You’ll lead the design of next-generation qubit chips and modular, scalable QPU architecture, working from on-chip subsystem architecture to EM simulations, frequency allocation, crosstalk management, packaging, and interconnect strategies.

You’ll also design and optimise nonreciprocal superconducting circuits, such as isolators and parametric amplifiers that will drive robust, high-fidelity readout chains. These designs will enhance readout signal-to-noise ratio and stability, feeding into our next-gen readout modules and ensuring seamless coupling with the qubit layer.

This role is highly collaborative: you’ll work in a tight feedback loop with experimentalists and device engineers to transform measurement insights into rapid design iterations, pushing performance, coherence, yield, and manufacturability across the full qubit stack.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design and simulate cutting-edge quantum hardware to improve performance, coherence, and scalability.

  • Develop high-performance, manufacturable device architectures that accelerate R&D cycles and increase qubit fidelity and yield.

  • Architect and optimize the layout of nonreciprocal superconducting circuits such as parametric amplifiers, targeting robust performance under cryogenic conditions.

  • Interpret simulation results and correlate with experimental data to guide iterative design improvements.

  • Collaborate across teams to ensure rapid design-to-test cycles, connecting theory with experiment.

  • Automate the design pipeline using Python, enabling parametric device generation, simulation sweeps, and data post-processing.

Your profile

  • MSc in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field, with 2+ years of industry experience or a PhD with relevant hands-on work

  • Strong Python skills for automating designs, controlling simulations, and analyzing data

  • Experience with EM simulation and chip design tools (e.g. Ansys HFSS-Q3D, KLayout); Git and Qiskit-Metal familiarity is a plus

  • Knowledge of cQED devices and superconducting circuit design is a strong advantage

  • Experience designing nonreciprocal superconducting circuits (e.g. parametric amplifiers) or advanced readout techniques is highly valued

  • Solid grasp of microwave engineering, quantum noise sources, and fabrication methods

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

data.title: Project & Account Manager B2B
data.description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. En naast individuele woningeigenaren werken we ook steeds meer samen met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders die grotere aantallen woningen willen verduurzamen.

Daarom zoeken we een B2B Account & Project Manager die deze projecten van begin tot eind in goede banen leidt. Iemand die overzicht houdt, afspraken nakomt en ervoor zorgt dat klanten, bewoners, installateurs en interne teams weten waar ze aan toe zijn.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze zakelijke klanten en de mensen die de projecten uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat plannen niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook in de praktijk werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grotere warmtepompprojecten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn.

Je zorgt dat projecten soepel verlopen

  • Je vertaalt afspraken met zakelijke klanten naar een concreet projectplan met duidelijke deadlines, verantwoordelijkheden en deliverables.

  • Je bewaakt de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en afgesproken KPI's van projecten.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met onze Installation Quality Specialist aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van projecten. Jij houdt de regie over het totale project, terwijl de Installation Quality Specialist de technische kwaliteit bewaakt.

  • Je stemt de voorbereiding en uitvoering af met onze interne teams, installateurs en externe partners.

  • Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten vroegtijdig en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost voordat ze de voortgang in gevaar brengen.

  • Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten tegelijk en stelt prioriteiten waar nodig.

Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze zakelijke klanten

  • Je onderhoudt relaties met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders.

  • Je zorgt dat klanten weten wat ze kunnen verwachten, hoe projecten ervoor staan en welke beslissingen nodig zijn.

  • Je organiseert de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen, van de opdrachtgever tot de bewoners en installatieteams.

  • Je rapporteert over de voortgang, resultaten en kwaliteit van projecten en bespreekt verbeterpunten met klanten.

  • Je bouwt aan langdurige klantrelaties door afspraken waar te maken en problemen goed op te lossen.

Je helpt ons steeds slimmer te werken

  • Je kijkt kritisch naar hoe we grotere installatieprojecten organiseren en uitvoeren.

  • Je gebruikt projectdata en KPI's om te begrijpen wat goed gaat en waar we kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je helpt processen te ontwikkelen waarmee we steeds grotere aantallen woningen efficiënt en met hoge kwaliteit kunnen verduurzamen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die structuur kan aanbrengen in complexe projecten, maar ook pragmatisch is wanneer de werkelijkheid anders loopt dan gepland. Je kunt schakelen tussen een gesprek met een vastgoedmanager en het oplossen van een praktisch probleem met een installatieteam.

Dit vinden we belangrijk:

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmanagement, waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijk was voor planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaten.

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern.

  • Je weet hoe je meerdere projecten, deadlines en belangen tegelijkertijd managet zonder het overzicht te verliezen.

  • Je bent gewend om met KPI's te werken en hierover helder te rapporteren.

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap. Als iets niet volgens plan loopt, wacht je niet af maar kom je met een oplossing.

  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je goed redden in het Engels.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector.

  • Ervaring met de uitrol van grotere verduurzamings-, installatie- of renovatieprojecten.

  • Affiniteit met warmtepompen, installatietechniek of de energietransitie.

Je hoeft dus geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Belangrijker is dat je weet hoe je een complex project succesvol organiseert, mensen meekrijgt en resultaten behaalt.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Bij DeWarmte krijg je de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je werkt niet aan abstracte plannen, maar aan projecten die ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer woningen daadwerkelijk van het gas af kunnen.

We zijn een groeiende scale-up met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en weinig bureaucratie. Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, verbeteringen door te voeren en mee te bouwen aan hoe we onze B2B-projecten in de toekomst organiseren.

Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende teams die allemaal hetzelfde doel hebben: slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen toegankelijk maken voor zoveel mogelijk huishoudens.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe impact op de groei van DeWarmte.

  • De kans om mee te bouwen aan onze B2B-activiteiten en de manier waarop we grotere projecten uitvoeren.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ontwikkeling en het verbeteren van processen.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3500 en €5000 per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • Via ons SAR-programma (Stock Appreciation Rights) deel je mee in het financiële succes van DeWarmte en profiteer je van de waarde die we samen opbouwen.

  • Een fijne werkplek in Den Haag, met de mogelijkheid om ook op projectlocaties te werken.

  • Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • Gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor.

  • Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je leuk om grotere verduurzamingsprojecten van plan naar praktijk te brengen? En krijg je energie van het organiseren, verbinden en oplossen van problemen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Compensation: €3.5K – €5K per month

data.title: Klantadviseur Sales
data.description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard en steeds meer mensen weten ons te vinden. Daarom zoeken we een Klantadviseur Sales die ervoor zorgt dat iedere geïnteresseerde én bestaande klant snel en goed geholpen wordt.

Je hebt contact met klanten, voornamelijk telefonisch en via video. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en helpt iemand naar de logische volgende stap. Soms betekent dat een afspraak inplannen voor een Digitale Inspectie. Soms blijkt dat onze oplossing niet past. En soms help je een bestaande klant met een vraag nadat de warmtepomp al is geïnstalleerd.

Je hoeft bij binnenkomst geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Wel vinden we het belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en energie krijgt van veel klantcontact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en werkt over verschillende momenten in de customer journey.

Aan de voorkant van ons salesproces volg je nieuwe leads op. Je belt mensen die interesse hebben getoond in onze warmtepompen, ontdekt wat hun situatie en behoefte is en beoordeelt of een Digitale Inspectie een goede volgende stap is. Je legt helder uit hoe onze producten en het proces werken en zorgt dat goede leads daadwerkelijk verder komen.

Daarnaast help je bestaande klanten met vragen nadat ze voor DeWarmte hebben gekozen. Je luistert, zoekt uit wat er speelt en zorgt dat de klant verder wordt geholpen. Waar nodig schakel je met collega's uit andere teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • telefonisch contact hebt met potentiële en bestaande klanten;

  • nieuwe leads snel en zorgvuldig opvolgt;

  • doorvraagt om te begrijpen wat een klant nodig heeft en of DeWarmte bij de situatie past;

  • geïnteresseerde klanten begeleidt naar een concrete volgende stap;

  • bestaande klanten helpt met vragen en zorgt voor goede opvolging;

  • gesprekken en afspraken netjes vastlegt in ons CRM systeem;

  • terugbelafspraken en openstaande acties zelfstandig opvolgt;

  • via telefoon en videocalls vertrouwen opbouwt en onze producten duidelijk uitlegt;

  • signaleert waar klanten tegenaan lopen en die inzichten deelt met het team.

Wie zoeken we?

Voor deze rol vinden we je manier van werken belangrijker dan een specifiek diploma of aantal jaren ervaring.

Je bent sterk in communicatie. Je maakt makkelijk contact, luistert goed, vraagt door en kunt informatie op een eenvoudige manier uitleggen.

Je hebt daarnaast een commerciële drive. Je vindt het leuk om een gesprek ergens naartoe te brengen en durft een concrete vervolgstap voor te stellen. Je bent overtuigend zonder te pushen.

Je kunt goed kwalificeren. Je achterhaalt snel wat iemand zoekt, wat de situatie is en of het zinvol is om verder te gaan in het proces.

Ook houd je van tempo en resultaat. Op een drukke dag spreek je verschillende klanten. Dat geeft je eerder energie dan dat het je afschrikt.

En je werkt gestructureerd en zelfstandig. Als je iemand belooft donderdag terug te bellen, gebeurt dat ook. Leads, afspraken en acties blijven niet liggen.

Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring in sales is fijn, maar zeker niet de enige route naar deze functie. Misschien heb je gewerkt in inbound sales, telefonische verkoop, een callcenter, energie of telecom. Maar ook ervaring in bijvoorbeeld de horeca kan heel relevant zijn als je daar hebt geleerd om snel contact te maken, goed te luisteren en commercieel te denken.

Daarnaast is het mooi als je:

  • interesse hebt in techniek en duurzaamheid;

  • ervaring hebt met adviserende gesprekken of videocalls;

  • eerder met een CRM-systeem hebt gewerkt;

  • naast Nederlands ook goed Engels spreekt.

Technische kennis over warmtepompen verwachten we niet vanaf dag één. We leren je wat je moet weten. Wel verwachten we dat je nieuwsgierig bent en nieuwe informatie snel oppakt.

Praktisch

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

De functie is mogelijk vanaf 24 tot 40 uur per week.

We werken deels vanuit huis en deels samen op kantoor. Werk je op onze vaste kantoordagen maandag, woensdag en vrijdag, dan verwachten we dat je op die dagen vanuit ons kantoor in Den Haag werkt.

Waarom DeWarmte?

DeWarmte is een scale-up, dus je komt niet terecht in een omgeving waar alles al jarenlang vastligt. We groeien, leren en verbeteren continu.

Dat betekent dat we zoeken naar iemand die niet alleen zijn of haar gesprekken afwerkt, maar ook ziet wat beter kan. Merk je dat klanten steeds tegen hetzelfde probleem aanlopen? Dan horen we dat graag. Zie je een slimmere manier om leads op te volgen? Kom ermee.

Uiteindelijk hebben we één gezamenlijk doel: zoveel mogelijk huishoudens helpen om de overstap naar duurzaam verwarmen te maken. En ieder goed klantgesprek brengt ons daar een stap dichterbij.

Compensation: €2.6K – €2.9K per month • Offers Commission

data.title: Full Stack Engineer, Frontend-focused (Next.js + Django)
data.description:
At DeWarmte, we make smart, affordable heat pumps that help homes move away from gas. We design the hardware, software and services ourselves, so the quality of our software directly shapes how well our products work in people's homes.

We're growing fast, and the customer journey is growing with us. That's why we're looking for a frontend-focused Full Stack Developer to improve our web application - from the first visit and heat-pump advice to quotation, planning and installation. You'll spend most of your time in Next.js and React, making every interaction clear, fast and genuinely pleasant.

You'll work primarily in our TypeScript frontend (Next.js Pages Router, React 18), with focused changes to our Django backend when a feature needs them. You'll take customer-facing work from idea to production and see directly what it does for conversion, customer satisfaction and the workload of our teams.

AI tools are already part of how we build software. We use them where they help us move faster, but we do not lower the bar: anything we ship still needs to be secure, maintainable and correct. You'll help us get better at both.

Why this role matters

Make switching to a heat pump simple, clear and trustworthy—from first discovery to installation and beyond.

You'll join the team behind a web application that our customers use every day. You'll get to know it deeply, keep it reliable and improve it as we grow. Just as important: you'll help make sure knowledge and ownership are shared across the team.

What you'll do

Build a great customer experience

  • Build, test and deploy customer-facing features in Next.js and React, with supporting Django and API changes where needed.

  • Turn customer needs and designs into clear, responsive and accessible interfaces.

  • Build the flows that guide customers from first interest to advice, quote, order, planning and installation.

  • Keep improving conversion, speed and usability based on data and customer feedback.

Support customers after installation

  • Improve the flows customers use after installation, from questions and service requests to documents and updates.

  • Connect the web application with the workflows used by our sales, planning, installation and service teams.

  • Remove manual work and friction for customers and colleagues alike.

Strengthen the frontend platform

  • Improve frontend architecture, reusable components, performance, accessibility and SEO.

  • Improve automated frontend testing, CI/CD, monitoring and safe release practices.

  • Work with the Backend Developer to shape clear APIs and interfaces between the web application, apps and external systems.

  • Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation and repeatable engineering practices.

  • Review code and share knowledge by default.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.

  • Help the team improve its AI workflows, shared context and quality checks.

  • Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.

  • Hold AI-assisted code to the same standards as any other production code.

Work across the company

This role reaches beyond the software team. You'll work with marketing, sales, planning, installation, service and product development to solve today's customer and operational issues without compromising the platform for tomorrow.

What success looks like

In your first few months

  • You understand the customer journey end to end, the frontend architecture and where it connects to our backend.

  • You can independently ship frontend features and make focused Django or API changes when needed, using the team's review and release practices.

  • You've identified the biggest usability issues and frontend technical risks in the journey, and helped prioritise them.

As the role develops

  • New frontend features ship predictably, safely and with good test coverage.

  • More visitors become customers, and customers rarely need to contact us to know where they stand.

  • You take responsibility for the frontend architecture and significant parts of the customer journey.

  • The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.

  • Critical parts of the frontend are understood and maintained by more than one person.

Who we're looking for

  • Solid hands-on experience building and shipping production web applications, with most of your depth on the frontend.

  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, plus experience with Next.js; familiarity with the Pages Router is useful.

  • Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals, with a good eye for responsive design, accessibility and interaction details.

  • Experience building customer-facing flows such as onboarding, configurators, quotes, checkout or self-service portals.

  • A track record of taking functionality from design through implementation, testing and deployment to real-world use.

  • Comfortable working with REST APIs and making focused changes in Python/Django; deep backend specialisation is not required.

  • A good understanding of web performance, SEO, automated testing, CI/CD and observability.

  • You use AI coding tools in practice and understand both their value and their limits.

  • A feel for user experience and a knack for making complex information simple.

Experience with design systems, analytics or experimentation, e-commerce, CRM or planning integrations, or the energy or installation sector is useful, but not essential. What matters most is that you care about the customer experience and can take frontend work from idea to production.

How you work

  • You fix urgent problems without letting short-term workarounds become long-term architecture.

  • You think from the customer's perspective and judge your work by what it does for them.

  • You're comfortable moving between interaction details, frontend architecture and the API contract behind them.

  • You're curious about new AI tools, try them quickly and share what works.

  • You explain technical topics clearly to people from any background.

  • You share knowledge by default and care about what the team can own together.

What we offer

  • A role with direct impact on the customer journey that helps homeowners move away from gas.

  • A clear frontend focus, with enough Django scope to take features end to end.

  • Room to improve how we use AI tools across the software team.

  • A gross monthly salary of €5.000 – €7.000, based on full-time employment.

  • 27 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance.

  • The chance to share in DeWarmte's growth through our Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR) programme.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team and real responsibility from day one.

  • Daily lunch at the office.

  • A laptop, access to the AI tools we use and everything else you need to do your best work.

  • Regular team activities, including our annual Beach Day and Winter Trip.

  • Plenty of room to grow, develop yourself and make a lasting impact.

Interested?

Want to build the customer journey that makes it easier for thousands of homes to move away from gas? We'd like to meet you.

Compensation: €5K – €7K per month

data.title: App Developer (Flutter)
data.description:
At DeWarmte, we make smart, affordable heat pumps that help homes move away from gas. We design the hardware, software and services ourselves, so the quality of our software directly shapes how well our products work in people's homes.

We're growing fast, and both apps need to grow with us. That's why we're looking for an App Developer to build and improve our two Flutter apps. Homeowners use the customer app to control their heat pump. Installers and service engineers use the employee app to install and maintain heat pumps in the field.

You'll spend most of your time writing code: improving quality and reliability and shipping features to iOS and Android. Your work has a direct effect on comfort at home and on how efficiently our installation and service teams work.

AI tools are already part of how we build software. We use them where they help us move faster, but we do not lower the bar: anything we ship still needs to be secure, maintainable and correct. You'll help us get better at both.

Why this role matters

Build reliable, intuitive apps that give customers confident control of their heat pump and help our installation and service teams do great work in the field.

You'll join the team behind two apps used every day by customers, installers and service engineers. You'll get to know them deeply, keep them reliable and improve them as DeWarmte grows. Just as important: you'll help make sure knowledge and ownership are shared across the team.

What you'll do

Develop the DeWarmte apps

  • Build the features homeowners and installers to use and control heat pumps

  • Ensure that the DeWarmte apps stand out in the market with regards to usability functionality and innovation.

  • Make sure the app holds up in real-world conditions, like a basement with poor connectivity.

Build a strong app platform

  • Work directly in the production Dart/Flutter codebases for iOS and Android.

  • Design, build, test and release new features, from first sketch to the App Store and Google Play.

  • Evolve app architecture, state management and shared components across both apps.

  • Work with our backend developers on clean, well-documented APIs.

  • Improve automated testing, CI/CD, crash reporting, analytics and release practices.

  • Diagnose and fix issues that span the apps, our Django backend and devices in the field.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.

  • Help the team improve its AI workflows, shared context and quality checks.

  • Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.

  • Hold AI-assisted code to the same standards as any other production code.

Share ownership

  • Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices.

  • Write code that other engineers can easily understand, test and safely change.

  • Take part in code reviews and technical decision-making.

Work across the company

This role reaches beyond app development. You'll work with colleagues in product, backend, hardware, controls, installation and service—and listen closely to customers—to solve today's issues without compromising the apps for tomorrow.

What success looks like

In your first few months

  • You understand both apps, how they connect to our backend and heat pumps, and where the risks are.

  • You can independently build, debug and release changes to both apps through the team's review and release practices.

  • The most important technical debt and quality issues are visible and prioritised.

As the role develops

  • New features ship predictably, safely and with good test coverage.

  • Customers trust the app to control their heat pump: crash rates go down and app store ratings go up.

  • Thanks to the employee app, installations and service visits are faster and have fewer errors.

  • The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.

  • Both apps are understood and maintained by more than one person.

Who we're looking for

  • Solid hands-on experience building and shipping production mobile apps with Flutter and Dart.

  • Experience releasing and maintaining apps on both the App Store and Google Play.

  • A solid grasp of app architecture and state management (e.g. Riverpod, Bloc or Provider).

  • Experience integrating REST APIs, authentication and push notifications.

  • A track record of taking functionality from design through implementation, testing and release to real-world use.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: version control, automated testing, CI/CD, crash reporting and performance monitoring.

  • You use AI coding tools in practice and understand both their value and their limits.

  • A feel for user experience and a knack for making complex information simple.

  • The ability to bring clarity to an environment where systems and processes are still taking shape.

Experience with native iOS or Android development, offline-first apps, connected devices such as Bluetooth or Wi-Fi provisioning, IoT, energy or HVAC is useful, but not essential. What matters most is that you can learn a complex physical product and take responsibility from idea to release.

How you work

  • You fix urgent problems without letting short-term workarounds become long-term architecture.

  • You care about the details users notice, and the ones they don't.

  • You're curious about new AI tools, try them quickly and share what works.

  • You explain technical topics clearly to people from any background.

  • You balance shipping today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow.

  • You share knowledge by default and care about what the team can own together.

What we offer

  • A role with direct impact on the apps customers use at home and our teams use in the field.

  • The chance to shape both the app platform and the experience around it.

  • Room to improve how we use AI tools across the software team.

  • A gross monthly salary of [€4,500 – €6,000], based on full-time employment.

  • 27 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance.

  • The chance to share in DeWarmte's growth through our Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR) programme.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team and real responsibility from day one.

  • Daily lunch at the office.

  • A laptop, access to the AI tools we use and everything else you need to do your best work.

  • Regular team activities, including our annual Beach Day and Winter Trip.

  • Plenty of room to grow, develop yourself and make a lasting impact.

Interested?

Want to build the apps that customers and colleagues rely on every day? We'd like to meet you.

Compensation: €4K – €6K per month
